rows.name: Gertraud "Gertruda" Kosina
rows.relation: MOTHER OF MARTIN KOZINA - not in the tree at all
rows.citation: Krstna knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1812-1831, book p.28 - "den 18. Merz, Haus 10, Gertrud, ehelich, Vater: FRANZ KOSINAR, Hueblar, Mutter: MARIA DO[M]SHAN". She was 27 when she bore Martin. HER BROTHER IS JOHANN: his marriage of 6 January 1833 gives his father as "Franz Kosinar, Haeusler" and his mother as "Mina Tom[sh]shan, Haeuslerin" - the same couple. RETRACTION: on 21 September 2026 this entry was ELIMINATED here on the grounds that the surname "ends in a clear -r, so it is KOSNAR not Kosina". That was wrong. The -r is how THIS clerk writes the family name, and he writes it identically for Johann, whose own children are entered KOSINA by the next clerk. One family, two hands. HER DEATH, read 22 September 2026: Mrliska knjiga Kranj-Smartin 1870-1890, book p.69 - "5. - 7. [Marec 1880] · Zg. Bitno · 9 · JERA KOZINA, neomozena gostja · katolik · zenski · ALTER 65 let · bozjast in jetika · M. Zarnik". DIED 5 MARCH 1880, BURIED 7 MARCH, AGED 65, UNMARRIED, AT ZGORNJE BITNO 9 - THE HOUSE SHE BORE MARTIN IN. JERA is the Slovene short form of GERTRUDA. Baptised 18 March 1814, she died THIRTEEN DAYS SHORT OF HER SIXTY-SIXTH BIRTHDAY, so the clerk's 65 is exact. NEOMOZENA - never married, which is what the unehelich on Martin's baptism already said. GOSTJA - a lodger, the word for a woman living in a house that is not hers, in the house her brother Johann held. The cause is "bozjast in jetika": the falling sickness and consumption. RETRACTION, THE SAME DAY: this row said for two hours that SHE LEFT THE PARISH, on the grounds that her son's Senj marriage of January 1888 carries no dagger against her name. She had been dead eight years. An absent mark is not a record. Found by reading the 1870-1890 register opening by opening after the 1890-1911 one had given nothing. Matricula, NSAL sig. 00885 image 15, sig. 00899 image 37, sig. 03916 image 72, sig. 03917 read in full

rows.name: Ursula "Uršula" Sedej
rows.relation: SECOND WIFE of Johann Kozina - and she held the house after him
rows.citation: Poročna knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1856-1881 book p.54, entry of 28 May 1873 - "Ženin: ZGORNJE BITNO 72 · MARTIN BRENK, gost · katoliško · 48 · VDOVEC. NEVESTA: ZGORNJE BITNO 9 · URŠULA SEDEJ, PO RANJCIM MOŽU KOZINA, POSESTNICA · katoliško · 46 · VDOVA. Roditelja ženinova: ANTON BRENK, gruntar, in MARIA RAVNIKAR. RODITELJA NEVESTINA: ANDREJ SEDEJ, GRUNTAR NA NOVI OSLICI, in JERA ROJE. Priči: Janez Bašar, kajžar, and Lorenc Brenk, gruntar, both signing with a cross. Oznanjeno Stražišče 27. aprila 1873. Poročil Valentin Lah, kaplan". FOUR THINGS THIS ENTRY GIVES, AND THE ARCHIVE HAD NONE OF THEM. ONE, HER AGE: 46 in May 1873, so BORN ABOUT 1826-27. She was about 27 when Franziska was born in 1853 and about 33 at Maria in 1859, which fits. TWO, HER PARENTS: ANDREJ SEDEJ and JERA ROJE - a generation nobody had reached. THREE, WHERE SHE CAME FROM: her father is a gruntar NA NOVI OSLICI - Nova Oselica, in the Poljane valley south-west of Škofja Loka, twenty-five kilometres from Bitnje and IN ANOTHER PARISH. This archive had already concluded she came from outside Kranj-Šmartin, because her marriage to Johann is not in its register between April 1850 and February 1853; the conclusion was right and this names the place. FOUR, WHAT SHE WAS BY 1873: POSESTNICA - a property owner - AT ZGORNJE BITNO 9. Johann died in October 1868 a Häubler; five years later HIS WIDOW HOLDS THE HOUSE IN HER OWN NAME. AND IT SETTLES SOMETHING THIS ARCHIVE COULD NOT EXPLAIN. At her daughter Mina’s marriage in 1883 the bride is "gruntarska hči" and Janez Kozina "gruntar", which contradicted every other record of a man who was a kajžar all his life. HER FATHER WAS A GRUNTAR AND SHE WAS A POSESTNICA. The household had risen, and by 1883 the clerk was writing what it had become rather than what Johann had been. SHE REMARRIED A WIDOWER, Martin Brenk, a gost of Zgornje Bitno 72, five years after Johann died. Matricula, NSAL sig. 03918 image 55

rows.name: Andrej Sedej
rows.relation: FATHER of Ursula Sedej - a GRUNTAR at Nova Oselica, and a generation nobody had reached
rows.citation: Poročna knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1856-1881 book p.54 - at his daughter’s second marriage on 28 May 1873 the bride’s parents are entered "ANDREJ SEDEJ, GRUNTAR NA NOVI OSLICI" and "JERA ROJE". A GRUNTAR is a full peasant farmer, a rung above the kajžar his daughter married. NOVA OSELICA is in the Poljane valley south-west of Škofja Loka, some twenty-five kilometres from Zgornje Bitnje AND IN ANOTHER PARISH - which is why Ursula’s first marriage is not in the Kranj-Šmartin book, and where her baptism of about 1826-27 should be. NOVA OSELICA HAS NOW BEEN OPENED, 28 September 2026, and SEDEJ IS A REAL, RESIDENT FAMILY THERE - walking the baptismal register (sig. 01584, 1826-1862) and the marriage register (sig. 01590, 1826-1908) turned up GERTRAUD SEDEJ and CATHARINA SEDEJ as mothers of brides marrying in January 1827, AGNES SEDEJ standing godmother in the same years, and an ANDRE SEDEJ, "½ Hüblor", fathering a child with MARIA BRIZ about 1829-30 (sig. 01584 image 14). NONE OF THESE IS PROVED TO BE THIS ANDREJ. The 1873 marriage names his wife JERA ROJE, not Maria Briz - so either this is a different Andre Sedej of the same generation, or Maria Briz was an earlier wife who died before Ursula was born (the pattern this archive has now met twice, at Johann Kozina’s own house). THE BAPTISMAL WALK COVERED SIG. 01584 IMAGES 3-25 (1826 to about 1832) AND DID NOT FIND URSULA’S OWN ENTRY, nor an Andrej Sedej x Jera Roje pairing as parents. The marriage register 01589 (1785-1826) was checked at its final pages (images 38-44, 1824 to January 1826) and 01590 from its start (images 1-8, 1826-1828): no Andrej Sedej x Jera Roje marriage in either window. EITHER THEIR MARRIAGE OR URSULA’S BAPTISM IS ELSEWHERE IN THESE 99 AND 87 IMAGES, most of which have not been read, or their marriage is in the earlier volume 01588 (1763-1784) or 01583 (1785-1826, the baptismal volume before 01584). NOT PROVED, AND NOT FALSE - the parish is confirmed open and free, and the next session can pick up exactly where this one stopped. Matricula, NSAL sig. 03918 image 55, sig. 01584 images 3-25, sig. 01589 images 38-44, sig. 01590 images 1-8

rows.name: Jera Roje
rows.relation: MOTHER of Ursula Sedej - named once, at her daughter’s second wedding
rows.citation: Poročna knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1856-1881 book p.54 - "Roditelja nevestina: Andrej Sedej, gruntar na novi Oslici, in JERA ROJE". JERA is the Slovene short form of GERTRUDA, the same name Martin Kozina’s mother carried at Zgornje Bitno 9 - a coincidence of given names in one parish and nothing more. NOVA OSELICA WAS OPENED FOR HER ON 28 September 2026 and did not give her up. The baptismal register (sig. 01584) and the start of the marriage register (sig. 01590) were walked for 1826-1832 and 1826-1828 and neither carries a Jera Roje beside an Andrej Sedej. AN ANDRE SEDEJ DOES APPEAR, married to MARIA BRIZ, fathering a child about 1829-30 - not proved to be the same man, and if it is, Jera Roje is a second wife the walk has not yet reached. SHE STILL EXISTS IN THIS ARCHIVE IN SIX WORDS. The volumes that would settle it - 01584 beyond image 25, 01589 before image 38, 01590 beyond image 8, and the two volumes before them both - are open, free, and not yet read past the pages named here. AND THE SURNAME ITSELF IS NOW INDEPENDENTLY CONFIRMED, separately from her husband’s family. Krstna knjiga Nova Oselica 1826-1862 (sig. 01584), image 36, gives an entry naming the mother "AGNES ROJ[S]KA" - the adjectival feminine form Slovene registers give a woman surnamed ROJE, exactly as this clerk’s contemporaries write "Kajzarska" for a woman of the Kajzar house. SO ROJE, LIKE SEDEJ, IS A REAL SURNAME IN THIS SAME PARISH AND NOT A MISREADING. Not the same woman as Jera - this Agnes bore a child outside marriage, later legitimised, a different case entirely - but it means the 1873 marriage record’s "Jera Roje" is not an isolated, unverifiable name: both halves of it belong to Nova Oselica. Matricula, NSAL sig. 03918 image 55, sig. 01584 images 3-36, sig. 01590 images 1-8

rows.name: Andre Sedej and Maria Briz
rows.relation: a Sedej household at Nova Oselica fathering children about 1829-30 - possibly Andrej and an earlier wife
rows.citation: Krstna knjiga Nova Oselica 1826-1862 (sig. 01584), image 14 - "ANDRE SEDEJ, ½ Hüblor" named as father, "MARIA BRIZ" as mother, in an entry the archive’s own year-heading dates to 1829 or 1830. FOUND WHILE WALKING THE REGISTER FOR URSULA SEDEJ’S OWN BAPTISM (found.psv, her row). THE WIFE’S NAME DOES NOT MATCH: Ursula’s mother in 1873 is JERA ROJE. Two readings are open and neither is settled - this is a DIFFERENT Andrej Sedej of the same generation and parish, or MARIA BRIZ IS A FIRST WIFE who died before Jera Roje married him, exactly the pattern this archive has already documented once, at Johann Kozina’s own house forty kilometres away. NOTHING HERE PROVES EITHER. ½ Hüblor is a half-cottager, a smaller holding than the GRUNTAR Ursula’s father is called in 1873, which is some evidence against the identification unless the household rose in the years between, which is exactly what this archive found at Zgornje Bitnje 9 as well. Matricula, NSAL sig. 01584 image 14

rows.name: Johann Kosina
rows.relation: BROTHER OF GERTRAUD, Haeusler at Oberfeichting No. 9
rows.citation: Poročna knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1816-1855, book p.35 - "1833, 6. Jaenner, Obern feichting 9, JOHANN KOSINAR, Haeusler, katholisch, 30 Jahre, ledig" marrying "LUZIA LABORNIK, 38, ledig". HIS PARENTS: "Franz Kosinar, Haeusler" and "Mina Tom[sh]shan, Haeuslerin". Born about 1802-03. THE BRIDE IS THE PROOF: Johann Kosina, Haeusler of Oberfeichting 9, had his first child with Lucia Labornik on 20 January 1834, a year and a fortnight later - so the house, the trade, the wife and the date all agree and the identification does not rest on the surname at all. Children ANTON 1834 and PETRUS 1836 at Oberfeichting 9 by Lucia Labornik; then, by a second wife URSULA SEDEJ, three daughters whose days are now all read: FRANZISKA baptised 19 September 1853, ANNA born and baptised 25 July 1856, MARIA born and baptised 7 August 1859 - six children over twenty-five years in one house, and he was about sixty-one at the last of them. CORRECTED 27 September 2026: this row said FRANZ 1853. The register says FRANCISCA and ticks Maedchen. And MARIA 1859 is new - the K section of the baptismal index was read end to end that day and it holds SIX Kozina, not five. HIS DEATH, found 27 September 2026 at the end of the walk that the index had made necessary: Mrliska knjiga Kranj-Smartin 1836-1869 book p.167 - "1868, October · 10. gestorben, 12. begraben · ZGORNJE BITNO · 9 · JOHANN KOZINA, Haubler · katholisch · maennlich · ALTER 64 Jahre · Auszehrung". DIED 10 OCTOBER 1868, BURIED 12 OCTOBER, AGED 64, AT ZGORNJE BITNO 9 - the Slovene name for Oberfeichting, and the same house. Age 64 puts his birth at about 1804 against the 30 he gave at his marriage in January 1833, which gives 1802-03: a two-year spread, which is what register ages do. He is a HAUBLER to the end, the word he carried at his wedding thirty-five years earlier. THE INDEX FOR 1836-1869 DOES NOT LIST HIM, and he is the seventh of the nine Kozina in that register that it missed. HE IS NAMED ONE LAST TIME, FIFTEEN YEARS AFTER HE DIED: at his daughter Maria’s marriage of 1883 (sig. 03919 book p.14) the bride’s parents are entered "JANEZ KOZINA, GRUNTAR, in URŠA SEDEJ" - the Slovene forms of his name and his second wife’s, and the record that joins the "unplaced" Marija Kozina of Stražišče to this household. THE WORD GRUNTAR DOES NOT FIT HIM and is recorded as read: he is a Häubler at his wedding in 1833, a Hüblar at every baptism, and a Häubler at his death in 1868. HIS SECOND MARRIAGE IS NOT IN THIS PARISH, and that was read rather than assumed. Lucia Labornik died 30 November 1850; Franziska was baptised 19 September 1853 and entered EHELICH, so the marriage to Ursula Sedej falls between those dates. Poročna knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1816-1855 was walked for it on 28 September 2026 - book pages 66, 67, 68, 69, 70 and 71, which run from APRIL 1850 to FEBRUARY 1853 without a gap. THERE IS NO KOZINA MARRIAGE ON ANY OF THEM. AND THE LIKELIEST REASON IS THE ORDINARY RULE: a marriage is celebrated in the BRIDE’S parish. Johann’s first marriage is in this book because LUCIA LABORNIK was local. If URSULA SEDEJ was not, the entry - and both sets of parents with it - is in her parish’s book and not in this one. SO URSULA SEDEJ CAME FROM SOMEWHERE ELSE, on the evidence of where her marriage is not. HIS TWO SONS’ BAPTISMS, OPENED IN FULL 28 September 2026, and they gave a household the archive had not seen. ANTON: "20. Jänner [1834] · Oberfeichting · 9 · ANTON · katholisch · Knaben · ehelich · Vater: JOHANN KOSINA, Häubler · Mutter: LUCIA · Paten: STEPHAN SH[E]SNAR, Hüblar, and MARIA DOLLENZ". PETRUS: "29. Juni [1836] · Oberfeichting · 9 · PETRUS · katholisch · Knaben · ehelich · Vater: [Johann] KOSINA · Mutter: LUCIA LABORNIK, written in full · Pate: JAKOB DOLENZ, signing with a cross". THE MOTHER’S SURNAME AT PETRUS’S BAPTISM IS THE CONFIRMATION - until now Lucia Labornik was known from her marriage and her death, and the two boys were hers only by inference from the house. AND THE GODPARENTS ARE A FINDING OF THEIR OWN. A DOLENC STANDS AT FOUR BAPTISMS OF THIS HOUSEHOLD ACROSS FORTY-ONE YEARS: JAKOB DOLLENZ in 1812 at Elisabeth’s, MARIA DOLLENZ in 1834 at Anton’s, JAKOB DOLENZ in 1836 at Petrus’s, and MARINA DOLENC in 1853 at Francisca’s. Jakob appears in 1812 and again in 1836, twenty-four years apart - one man, or a father and a son. KUMSTVO IS NOT A COURTESY in this culture; it is a standing bond between two households, and this is the only one this archive has documented for the Kosinar. IT ALSO GIVES A SURNAME TO SEARCH: a Dolenc marriage at Kranj-Šmartin would say how close the two families were. Matricula, NSAL sig. 00899 images 37 and 69-74, sig. 00886 images 19 and 34, sig. 03919 image 15

rows.name: Lucia Labornik
rows.relation: first wife of Johann Kosina
rows.citation: Mrliska knjiga Kranj-Smartin 1836-1869, book p.71 - "30. - 2. Xbr [1850] · Ob. Feichtg · 9 · LUZIA KOSINA, Hueblersweib · katholisch · weiblich · ALTER 55 · Lungenentzuendung · versehen · Jos. Kartely". DIED 30 NOVEMBER 1850, BURIED 2 DECEMBER, AGED 55, so born about 1795 - and she was 38 at her marriage in January 1833, which gives 1794-95. THE SAME WOMAN. She is entered a Hueblers-WEIB and not a widow, which is right: Johann outlived her. AND IT EXPLAINS THE SECOND WIFE - Johann is beside Ursula Sedej by 1853 because Lucia died in 1850. Married 6 January 1833 aged 38 to Johann Kosina, Haeusler of Oberfeichting 9 (Porocna knjiga 1816-1855 p.35); her parents "Ma[thes] Labornik, Haeusler" and "Gertraud Mag[nishan]"; mother of Anton 1834 and Petrus 1836. SAME HOUSE AND SAME DISEASE AS FRANZ, twenty-two months apart. Matricula, NSAL sig. 00899 image 37 and sig. 00895 image 72

rows.name: Franz Kosinar
rows.relation: GRANDFATHER OF MARTIN KOZINA - father of Gertraud and Johann
rows.place: Feichting bei St. Johann 10, župnija Kranj-Šmartin
rows.citation: Poročna knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1780-1815, read 22 September 2026 - "Den 27ten [8ber 1800] · Feichting b. St. Joh. · 10. · FRANZ KOSINAR · katholisch · 24 · ledig" marrying "MARIA DORTSHEN · katholisch · 20 · ledig". Witnesses "MATTHAEUS KOSINAR" and "Simon Rauth", Bauern, Matthaeus signing with a cross; married by "Matthaeus Lauts, coop.", Pfarrer St. Martin. SO HE WAS BORN ABOUT 1776 and she about 1780. Named again as "Franz Kosinar, Hueblar" at his daughter GERTRAUD's baptism, 18 March 1814 at HOUSE 10 (sig. 00885 image 15), and as "Franz Kosinar, Haeusler" in the Aeltern des Braeutigams column at his son JOHANN's marriage of 6 January 1833 (sig. 00899 image 37). He is Martin Kozina's grandfather, four generations above Hedviga. HIS OWN BAPTISM WAS LOOKED FOR ON 27 SEPTEMBER 2026 AND IS NOT IN THE INDEX. The baptismal index for 1603-1779 (sig. 04.. 00872, 146 images) is arranged by initial letter and then CHRONOLOGICALLY, giving surname, given name, the FATHER in brackets and a date - and no page number, so it finds a date and not a page. The K section runs to about image 72, where it ends at 1779. Images 71 and 72 were read in full at 3.2x and cover 1772 to 1779 without a gap. THERE IS NO FRANZ KOSINAR OR KOSINA IN 1774, 1775, 1776 OR 1777 - the window his two independent ages require (24 at his marriage in October 1800, 73 at his death in January 1849, both giving 1775-76). THAT IS NOT A CONCLUSION AND THIS ARCHIVE HAS BEEN BURNED BY TREATING IT AS ONE. An index proves what it contains and never what it omits, and this parish’s own death index for 1836-1869 missed NINE Kozina. The register itself (sig. 00883, 363 images) has NOT been walked for those four years, and until it is, "not in the index" is all this says. THE OTHER READING is that he was baptised in another parish and married in, which the 1800 marriage does not say either way. HIS DEATH, read 22 September 2026: Mrliska knjiga Kranj-Smartin 1836-1869 book p.61 - "22. - 24. [Jaenner 1849] · Ob. Feichtg · 9 · FRANZ KOSINA, Ausnehmer · katholisch · maennlich · ALTER 73 · Lungenentzuendung · versehen". DIED 22 JANUARY 1849, BURIED 24 JANUARY, AGED 73 - which puts his birth at 1775-76 and CONFIRMS the age of 24 he gave at his marriage, from a second and independent record. He is an AUSNEHMER, a retired householder living on the Ausnahm, and he died at OBERFEICHTING No. 9. CORRECTED 22 September 2026: this row said he had 'retired into his son's house'. HOUSE 9 WAS HIS OWN. His son Valentin was baptised there on 15 February 1820 with Franz entered HAUBLER, the man of the house (sig. 00885 image 55), and Elisabeth was baptised at house 9 in 1812. He held 9, his son Johann was keeping it by 1833, his grandson MARTIN WAS BORN IN IT in 1841, and he died in it as an Ausnehmer in 1849. He did not move in with his son; he handed the house over and stayed in it. The family were at house 10 in 1814-15 and at 9 before and after, so the two numbers are a move and not two households. Matricula, NSAL sig. 00901 image 33 and sig. 00895 image 62

rows.name: Maria "Mina" Dortschen
rows.relation: GRANDMOTHER OF MARTIN KOZINA - wife of Franz Kosinar
rows.place: Feichting bei St. Johann, župnija Kranj-Šmartin
rows.citation: Poročna knjiga 1780-1815 - "MARIA DORTSHEN, katholisch, 20, ledig", marrying Franz Kosinar on 27 October 1800, SO BORN ABOUT 1780. THE SURNAME, from six clerks across thirty-three years: "Dortshen" 1800 · "Dortschen" at Elisabeth's baptism 1812 · "Do[m]shan" at Gertraud's 1814 · "Dortschen" at Maria's 1815 · "Dortschen" at Valentin's 1820 · "Tom[sh]shan" at Johann's marriage 1833. FOUR OF THE SIX READ DORTSCHEN and the archive now leads with it; the other two are this archive's own bracketed readings and are kept as read. MINA is the short form these registers use for Marija, and one clerk writes MARINA. SIX OF HER CHILDREN ARE NOW KNOWN BY NAME: Johann about 1802, Elisabeth 1812, Gertraud 1814, Maria 1815, MARIA 1818 and Valentin 1820 - and THREE OF THE SIX died before they were a year old. THE SECOND MARIA, read 22 September 2026, is named for the sister who had died in March 1816, which is ordinary practice and is why this archive counted five for part of one evening and then six. Two index entries were long unaccounted for - Kosina Dorothea p.8 (1813) and Kosina Marianna p.16 (1813). CORRECTED 27 September 2026: this row said BOTH PAGES WERE OPENED and the whole father column of each read at 2.4x, and that THERE IS NO KOSINA ON EITHER. THAT WAS WRONG FOR PAGE 16. Re-read at nine times magnification, the entry of 12 August 1813 at house 27 gives MARIANNA, father LUKAS KOSINER, Kaischler - and she is almost certainly the Marianna Kosina who died at Breg 12 in 1840 aged 26. Two and a half times was not enough for that hand. CORRECTED AGAIN THE SAME DAY, AND FOR THE SAME REASON. For an hour this row also said PAGE 8 STILL HAS NO KOSINA, on the strength of a 3.2x pass that found two Dorotheas - house 28 to Primus Wit[nitz] and house 18 to Johann Holz. THERE ARE THREE DOROTHEAS ON PAGE 8. The third is "6. [Hornung 1813] · 12 · DOROTHEA · ehelich · Vater: ANTON KOSINER RECTE KATZIN, Inwohner · Mutter: MARGARETH ZUBERTH". The whole father column has now been read at 8x and she is the only Kosiner on it. BOTH INDEX ENTRIES ARE THEREFORE ACCOUNTED FOR - and NEITHER CHILD IS HERS: Marianna is Lukas Kosina’s, and Dorothea is Anton’s. AND ANTON’S ENTRY CARRIES A WARNING FOR THIS WHOLE FILE: RECTE marks the legal surname against the name in daily use, so the family name is KATZIN and KOSINER is what they were called - most likely after the house. A Kosina in this index is not always a Kosina in the family. SHE WAS ALIVE IN FEBRUARY 1820, at about forty, because Valentin was baptised then and entered ehelich. HER DEATH IS STILL NOT FOUND, and the search is now exhaustive for this parish: the K section of the death index for 1812-1835 (sig. 04634, images 125-126) was read end to end on 22 September 2026 and holds SIX Kozina - Elisabeth 1813 p.6, TWO Maria 1816 both p.34, Matthäus 1819 p.64, Valentin 1820 p.72, Margareth 1826 p.132 - and the two 1816 Marias are a woman of 78 and a baby of nine months, NEITHER of them her. The index for 1836-1869 (sig. 04635) holds only Franz 1849 and Luzia 1850. HER DEATH, FOUND 27 SEPTEMBER 2026 by walking the 1836-1869 register itself rather than trusting its index: Mrliska knjiga Kranj-Smartin 1836-1869 book p.27 - "1841, April · am 11. gestorben, am 13. begraben · OBERFEICHTING [ditto] · 9 · MARIA KOSINA, AUSZUGLERIN · katholisch · weiblich · ALTER 60 Jahre · Convulsionen · versehen". DIED 11 APRIL 1841, BURIED 13 APRIL, AGED 60, AT OBERFEICHTING 9. Born about 1781, which is the 20 she gave at her marriage in October 1800. AUSZUGLERIN is the female of AUSNEHMER - a householder who has handed over and lives on the Ausnahm - and it is the exact word this same register uses for FRANZ at his own death in THE SAME HOUSE eight years later (p.61, 22 January 1849, aged 73). SHE DIED IN THE HOUSE SHE HAD HANDED OVER. AND THE DATE IS THE ONE THAT MATTERS: her grandson MARTIN WAS BORN IN THAT HOUSE ON 16 NOVEMBER 1841, SEVEN MONTHS AFTER SHE DIED IN IT. THE INDEX FOR 1836-1869 DOES NOT LIST HER, and that is now the fourth positive proof that it is incomplete - it holds Franz 1849 and Luzia 1850 and nobody else, while the register itself yields Marianna 1840, MARIA 1841, Joseph 1843 and Ursula 1845/46 in the first 105 pages alone. An index proves what it contains and never what it omits. Matricula, NSAL sig. 00901 image 33, sig. 00885 images 4, 15, 23 and 55, sig. 00899 image 37

rows.name: Matthaeus Kosinar
rows.relation: witness at Franz Kosinar's marriage - and his DEATH says brother, not father
rows.citation: Poročna knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1780-1815 - one of the two Beystände at the marriage of Franz Kosinar and Maria Dortschen on 27 October 1800, entered "MATTHAEUS KOSINAR" and SIGNING WITH A CROSS, so he could not write. The other witness is "Simon Rauth"; both are entered "Bauern". HIS DEATH, read 22 September 2026: Mrliška knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1812-1835 book p.64 - "1819, den 16ten April · Ober-Feichting · 14 · MATTHÄUS KOSINA · Keischler · katholisch · männlich · ALTER 45 · Rothlauf und Brand". DIED 16 APRIL 1819, AGED 45, so born about 1774 - WHICH ANSWERS THE OPEN QUESTION. Franz was born 1775-76. Two men born a year or two apart are not father and son, so the man who stood witness in 1800 was FRANZ'S BROTHER and was twenty-six when he did it. He is the only Matthäus Kozina in the parish death index for 1812-1835. Matricula, NSAL sig. 00901 image 33 and sig. 00894 image 33

rows.name: Lukas Kosina the elder
rows.relation: A KOSINA FATHERING CHILDREN 1773-1779 - the candidate father of Franz, Matthaeus and Lukas
rows.citation: Krstni index Kranj-Šmartin 1603-1779, the K section, read 27 September 2026 - TWO ENTRIES: "KOSINA GERTRUD (Lukas) 2.3." under 1773, and "KOSINA HELENA (Lukas) 26.4." under 1779. The index gives the FATHER in brackets and a date, and no page, so these are two daughters of a LUKAS KOSINA baptised six years apart. HE CANNOT BE THE LUKAS THIS ARCHIVE ALREADY HAS. That Lukas married in 1799 aged 29, so he was born about 1770 and was three years old when Gertrud was baptised. THIS IS AN OLDER MAN OF THE SAME NAME, fathering children at Kranj-Šmartin from 1773. AND THAT IS EXACTLY THE GENERATION THIS ARCHIVE HAS BEEN SHORT OF. Its three earliest Kosina men are MATTHAEUS born about 1774, FRANZ born 1775-76 and LUKAS born about 1770 - three men born inside six years, whom the archive has only ever been able to call brothers on the arithmetic of their ages. A Lukas Kosina fathering children in 1773 and 1779 is a candidate for their father, and the 1773 and 1779 girls would be their sisters. NOTHING PROVES IT. No entry yet read names Lukas the elder’s wife, his house or his village, and the two baptisms have NOT been opened - the index carries no page number and the register (sig. 00883) has not been walked to find them. THE TEST IS THE HOUSE: if either girl is baptised at Oberfeichting 9, the house Franz held and died in, the case is made; if neither is, it is not. THE REST OF THE K SECTION, 1747 to 1772, HAS NOT BEEN READ, so there may be more of them. Matricula, NSAL sig. 00872 images 71 and 72

rows.name: Lukas Kosina
rows.relation: married 1799 aged 29 - father of the OTHER Gertraud, and not ours
rows.citation: Poročna knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1780-1815 - "LUKAS KOSINA, katholisch, 29, ledig", married in 1799, so born about 1770. HE CLOSES AN OPEN QUESTION: the 1812-1831 baptismal index offered TWO Gertraud candidates, and the 1818 one (book p.72, house 12) had a father whose surname could not be read - "Lukas Ko[s]in..." - at the resolution Matricula serves. This is that man. The 1818 Gertraud is HIS daughter and not Franz's, which leaves the 1814 Gertraud as Martin's mother with no rival. HIS CHILDREN, 27 September 2026: TWO are now named, and his surname is no longer unreadable. Book p.16 gives MARIANNA, baptised 12 August 1813 at house 27, and book p.72 gives GERTRAUD, baptised 16 February 1818 at "Lemny" house 12 - the village as the clerk wrote it, not resolved. BOTH entries name the father LUKAS KOSINER, Kaischler, and both name the mother LUZIA; her surname is written differently in the two hands and neither reading is secure. At fourteen times magnification the surname is KOSINER on both, which is how these clerks write this family name - Franz is KOSINAR and KOSINER in the same decades. AND THE 1813 DAUGHTER IS ALMOST CERTAINLY THE MARIANNA KOSINA who died at BREG 12 on 10 January 1840, aged 26, a Keuschlerstochter: the age fits to the month and the trade is the same word. HIS VILLAGE, 27 September 2026: READ CLEANLY TWICE AND STILL NOT IDENTIFIED. The 1799 marriage puts him at "LEMY 37" and the 1818 baptism of his daughter Gertraud at "LEMNY 12" - the same short name in two hands nineteen years apart, and the column header of the 1818 page is "DER ORTEN", so it is a place and not anything else. At thirteen times magnification the 1799 form is four letters, a kurrent capital L, then e or o, then m, then y. IT MATCHES NO SETTLEMENT IN THE PARISH LIST Matricula publishes - but that list is NOT EXHAUSTIVE, because the same 1818 page carries "PRSCHAN" for Prase, which is not in it either. So the likeliest answer is a hamlet too small for a summary list, and this is a question for somebody who knows the ground rather than for more magnification. AND THERE IS ONE HYPOTHESIS WITH A NUMBER BEHIND IT. Lukas is at Lemny 12 in 1818; his daughter MARIANNA dies at BREG 12 in 1840. THE SAME HOUSE NUMBER, the same family, twenty-two years apart. Either the household moved from one village 12 to another village 12, which happens, or LEMY IS A PART OF BREG under a name the clerks used and the gazetteers do not. THE WORDS DO NOT RESEMBLE EACH OTHER, which is the weakness of it, and this archive is not going to turn a house number into a place name. Matricula, NSAL sig. 00901 image 31, sig. 00885 images 9 and 37

rows.name: Elisabeth Kosinar
rows.relation: DAUGHTER of Franz Kosinar and Maria Dortschen - died at five months
rows.place: Oberfeichting bei St. Ursula 9, župnija Kranj-Šmartin
rows.citation: BAPTISM: Krstna knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1812-1831 book p.6 - "18. [November 1812] · Haus 9 · ELISABETH · katholisch · weiblich · ehelich · Vater: FRANZ KOSINER · Mutter: MINA DORTSCHEN · Paten Jakob Dollenz and Elisabeth, signing with a cross · den 18ten um 3 Uhr früh". DEATH: Mrliška knjiga 1812-1835 book p.6 - "11. [April 1813] · Ober-Feichting W. Ursula · 9 · ELIZABETHA KOSINA · Tochter · katholisch · weiblich · ALTER 5 Monath · Fraiß". FIVE MONTHS OLD, of convulsions. She is the first of the three children of this marriage the archive has found who did not live. Indexed as "Kosina Elisabeth 6" in BOTH the baptismal index 1812-1831 and the death index 1812-1835. Matricula, NSAL sig. 00885 image 4, sig. 00894 image 4, sig. 04631 image 169, sig. 04634 image 125

rows.name: Maria Kosinar
rows.relation: DAUGHTER of Franz Kosinar and Maria Dortschen - died at nine months
rows.place: house 10, died at Oberfeichting 9, župnija Kranj-Šmartin
rows.citation: BAPTISM: Krstna knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1812-1831 book p.44 - "den 8ten [August 1815] · Haus 10 · MARIA · katholisch · weiblich · ehelich · Vater: FRANZ KOSINAR, Häubler · Mutter: MARIA DORTSCHEN · um 10 Uhr Nachmittag". DEATH: Mrliška knjiga 1812-1835 book p.34 - "den 31 [März 1816] · Oberfeichting · 9 · MARIA KOZINAR · Häubl[erskind] · katholisch · weiblich · ALTER 3/4 Jahr · Fraiß". Born 8 August 1815 and dead on 31 March 1816 is seven and a half months, which is what three quarters of a year means in this column. SHE IS ONE OF THE TWO «Kozina Maria - 34» the death index lists for 1816, and she is the one a reader would be looking for. Matricula, NSAL sig. 00885 image 23, sig. 00894 image 18, sig. 04631 image 169, sig. 04634 image 126

rows.name: Valentin Kosina
rows.relation: SON of Franz Kosinar and Maria Dortschen - died at one week
rows.citation: BAPTISM: Krstna knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1812-1831 book p.108 - "Den 15ten Hornung [February] 1820 · Ober-Feichting · 9 · VALENTIN · katholisch · männlich · ehelich · Vater: FRANZ KOSINA, HÄUBLER · Mutter: MARINA DORTSCHEN". DEATH: Mrliška knjiga 1812-1835 book p.72 - "Den 29ten Hornung · Ober-Feichting · 9 · VALENTIN KOSINA · Häubler · katholisch · männlich · ALTER 1 Woche · Fraiß". Fourteen days. THIS ENTRY IS THE PROOF OF THE HOUSE: it is the only record that names Franz, names Oberfeichting 9 and names him HÄUBLER there, twenty-one years before his grandson Martin was born in that house and twenty-nine before he died in it himself. AND IT DATES THE MOTHER: Maria Dortschen was bearing children in February 1820, so she was alive at about forty. 1820 was a leap year, so the 29th of February is a real date. Matricula, NSAL sig. 00885 image 55, sig. 00894 image 37, sig. 04631 image 169, sig. 04634 image 125

rows.name: Margaretha Kosinar
rows.relation: a Kosinar woman of Franz's own generation, dying in Franz's house - UNPLACED
rows.citation: Mrliška knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1812-1835 book p.130 - "14. März [1826] · Ober-Feichting · 9 · MARGARETHA KOZINAR · Häublers-Tochter · katholisch · weiblich · ALTER 45". BORN ABOUT 1781, and she died UNMARRIED - a Häubler's daughter at forty-five - IN THE HOUSE FRANZ KOSINAR KEPT. Franz was born 1775-76 and Matthäus about 1774, so a woman born about 1781 is of their generation and not of their children's: most likely FRANZ'S SISTER, living on in her brother's house. NOTHING HERE PROVES IT and no parents are named. The death index carries her as "Kozina Margareth - 132", one opening further on than the page she is actually written on, which is the only place this index has been caught out. Matricula, NSAL sig. 00894 image 66, sig. 04634 image 125

rows.name: Maria Kosinar the elder
rows.relation: a Kosinar woman born about 1738 - the oldest of the name yet reached - UNPLACED
rows.citation: Mrliška knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1812-1835 book p.34 - "Den 27 [Februar 1816] · Z[ubern] · 4 · MARIA KOZINAR · Häubl · katholisch · weiblich · ALTER 78 Jahre · Altersschwäche". SEVENTY-EIGHT, of old age, which puts her birth at about 1738 and makes her the oldest person of this name the archive has reached - a generation above Franz and Matthäus, who were born about 1775 and 1774. She is therefore a CANDIDATE FOR THEIR MOTHER and nothing more: the village is not Feichting, no husband is named, and this book names no parents. THE VILLAGE IS NOT SECURELY READ. It is written the same way twice on this page, house 4 both times, and at 9x it reads "Zubern" or "Luberan"; it is recorded as the clerk wrote it rather than resolved into a modern name. She is the SECOND of the two «Kozina Maria - 34» the index lists for 1816; the other is Franz's nine-month-old daughter. Matricula, NSAL sig. 00894 image 18, sig. 04634 image 126

rows.name: Maria Kosinar the second
rows.relation: DAUGHTER of Franz Kosinar and Maria Dortschen - named for the sister who died
rows.citation: Krstna knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1812-1831 book p.84 - "6ten Dezember [1818] · Ober-Feichting · [10 struck, 12 written] · MARIA · katholisch · weiblich · ehelich · Vater: FRANZ KOSINAR, Häusler · Mutter: MARIA DORTSCHAN, Häuslerin". THE REGISTER CALLS HER SIMPLY MARIA; this archive says "the second" because her sister of the same name had died on 31 March 1816, twenty months before she was born. Re-using a dead child's name is ordinary practice and is not a clerical error. HER HOUSE NUMBER IS CORRECTED ON THE PAGE, 10 struck and 12 written or the reverse - which is the third time these two numbers have moved under this family. Found by reading the K section of the baptismal index 1812-1831 (sig. 04631 image 169), which lists her as "Kosina Maria - 84". HER DEATH, found 27 September 2026: Mrliska knjiga Kranj-Smartin 1836-1869 book p.163 - "1868 · 6. gestorben, 8. begraben · ZGORNJE BITNO · 9 · MARIA KOSINA, LEDIGE INWOHNERIN · katholisch · weiblich · ALTER 49 Jahre · Auszehrung · Leopold Plinar, coop.". DIED 6 JANUARY 1868, AGED 49 - and she was baptised 6 DECEMBER 1818, so she had turned 49 exactly one month before she died. THE AGE IS EXACT. LEDIGE: she never married, and she was an INWOHNERIN, a lodger, in the house she was born in. HER SISTER GERTRAUD DIED IN THE SAME HOUSE TWELVE YEARS LATER, also unmarried, also entered as a lodger - «neomozena gostja». TWO SISTERS WHO NEVER LEFT AND NEVER MARRIED, in a house neither of them owned. The index lists neither. Matricula, NSAL sig. 00885 image 43, sig. 04631 image 169

rows.name: Marija "Mina" Kozina
rows.relation: DAUGHTER of Johann Kozina and Ursula Sedej - the same woman as Maria of 1859, joined on 27 September 2026
rows.citation: THE MARRIAGE, FOUND 27 September 2026 by walking the register this row had named as the document that would settle it: Poročna knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1881-1899, sig. 03919, book p.14 - "Ženin: STRAŽIŠE 120 · KANCIJAN ČESEN, kajžarski sin · katoliške · 32 · svoboden. NEVESTA: KOLODVOR V PODNARTU 12, ROJENA V ZGORNJEM BITNJU št. 9 · MINA KOZINA, gruntarska hči · katoliške · 23 · svobodna. Roditelja ženinova: MATEVŽ ČESEN, kajžar, in URŠA PETERNEL. RODITELJA NEVESTINA: JANEZ KOZINA, GRUNTAR, IN URŠA SEDEJ. Priči: Franc Sušnik, hišar, in Jošt Trebar, gostač, both signing with a cross. Poročil Gregor Slibar". TWO THINGS IN THAT ENTRY CLOSE THIS ROW. First, ROJENA V ZGORNJEM BITNJU ŠT. 9 - born at Zgornje Bitnje number 9, which is Franz Kosinar’s house, the house Martin was born in and Johann died in. Second, JANEZ KOZINA and URŠA SEDEJ are the Slovene forms of JOHANN KOZINA and URSULA SEDEJ. SHE IS THEIR YOUNGEST DAUGHTER, baptised 7 August 1859 at that house - and she was 23 at her marriage, which is exact. WHAT THIS ROW USED TO SAY: "the only Kozina woman in the parish in the 1890s, UNPLACED · NOTHING JOINS HER TO THIS FAMILY except the surname and the parish". It named the document that would settle it and said NOT YET OPENED. It has been opened, and it settles it. THE DATE IS A PROBLEM AND IS RECORDED AS ONE. The date cell reads "2. junija" - 2 June 1883 - but the entry’s own Dokaznice are dated 17 June (the Stražišče notice, št. 11), 21 JUNE (the imperial-royal court at Kranj declaring the UNDER-AGE BRIDE of full age, št. 3708) and 1 JULY (the banns from the parish of Dobrava). A marriage cannot precede its own banns by a month, and the row beneath it has the same cell and the same problem, so the month is a slip and the marriage is 2 JULY 1883. Recorded as read, with the conflict stated. AND ONE WORD DOES NOT FIT. She is "gruntarska hči" and her father "gruntar" - a farmer and a farmer’s daughter. Every other record of Johann Kozina calls him Häubler or kajžar, a cottager, including his own death in 1868. Either the household had risen, or the clerk wrote the higher word at a wedding; the birth house and both parents’ names are not in doubt. SHE WAS LIVING AT THE RAILWAY STATION AT PODNART, twenty kilometres from the house she was born in. HER CHILDREN: Mrliška knjiga 1890-1911 gives two of them dying at STRAŽIŠČE 84 - Kancijan, 1892, aged 1 3/4 months, and Pavla, 1893, aged 2 - both "zakonski otrok hišarja-dninarja Kancijana Česen in Marije roj. Kozina". AND THE SAME WALK DATES HER DEATH, WITHOUT FINDING IT. Eleven openings further on, at book p.55: "1896, 10. februarja · STRAŽIŠČE 84 · KANCIJAN ČESEN, hišar, VDOVEC, roj. 1. avgusta 1851, 44 let" marrying "FRANCIŠKA TOMAŽEVIČ, Stražišče 96, kajž. hči, roj. 26. marca 1849, 46 let". HE IS A WIDOWER AT THE HOUSE HER CHILDREN DIED IN. So MARIJA KOZINA DIED BETWEEN 1893, when her daughter Pavla died, and 10 FEBRUARY 1896 - aged between 33 and 36, leaving a husband who remarried within three years. HER DEATH, FOUND 27 September 2026, and the hypothesis that found it was right. Mrliška knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1890-1911 book p.45, entry 33 - "1895, April · 2. umrla, 3. pokopana · STRAŽIŠČE · 84 · MARIJA ČESEN, hišarja in sitarja žena · katoliške · ženskega · STAROST 35 LET · OTROŠKA MRZLICA · previdena · Alojzij Železny, kapelan". DIED 2 APRIL 1895, BURIED 3 APRIL, AGED 35, AT STRAŽIŠČE 84 - the house her children died in. Baptised 7 August 1859, she was 35 years and 8 months. THE AGE IS EXACT. AND SHE IS ENTERED MARIJA ČESEN, UNDER HER HUSBAND’S SURNAME, WITH NO MAIDEN NAME AT ALL. This archive walked that register opening by opening looking for KOZINA and could not have found her. The register is inconsistent about it - on the same openings "Marija roj. Eržen" and "Neža roj. Mravlje" keep their maiden names - so this was not a rule to be known in advance, and the walk was right while the query was wrong. OTROŠKA MRZLICA is childbed fever. For a married woman of thirty-five, among entries where the clerk gives grown people grown diseases, it is not a children’s fever; SHE DIED IN OR JUST AFTER CHILDBIRTH, and a baptism of early 1895 at Stražišče 84 has not been looked for. AND SHE WAS THE FOURTH DEATH IN THAT HOUSE IN THREE YEARS. Kancijan, 1892, at one and three quarter months. Pavla, 1893, at two. ANTONIJA ČESEN, "hišarja hči", 26 FEBRUARY 1895, AGED 1 1/2, of božjast and without the sacraments - born about August 1893, the year Pavla died, and dead FIVE WEEKS BEFORE HER MOTHER. Then Marija herself. Her husband Kancijan Česen remarried on 10 February 1896, ten months later. Matricula, NSAL sig. 03919 images 15 and 56, sig. 00886 image 160, sig. 03917 images 19, 25, 45 and 46 Matricula, NSAL sig. 03919 images 15 and 56, sig. 00886 image 160, sig. 03917 images 19 and 25

rows.name: Jožef Kozina
rows.relation: head of a KOZINA FARMING household at Kranj-Šmartin in the 1890s - UNPLACED
rows.citation: Poročna knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1881-1899, book p.59 - at the marriage of IGNACIJ KERT and FRANCIŠKA KOZINA in 1897 the bride’s parents are entered "JOŽEF KOZINA, 1/2 ZEMLJAK" and "MINA KODRAN". HE WAS ALIVE AND HE SIGNED: the Dokaznice column records "Očetovo privoljenje za mladoletno nevesto z dne 5. februarja 1897" - the father’s consent for an under-age bride - so Franciška was not yet twenty-four and was born after about 1873. A 1/2 ZEMLJAK is a half-holding farmer, which is a rung above the Häubler and kajžar this archive’s own Kozina were. NOTHING JOINS HIM TO JOHANN KOZINA of Zgornje Bitnje 9, who died in 1868, and the surname and the parish are the whole resemblance - except that Johann’s daughter is herself entered "gruntarska hči" at her marriage in 1883, which this archive cannot explain. Found by walking the marriage register for somebody else. Matricula, NSAL sig. 03919 image 60

rows.name: Franciška Kozina, married Kert
rows.relation: DAUGHTER of Jožef Kozina and Mina Kodran - UNPLACED
rows.citation: Poročna knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1881-1899, book p.59 - "IGNACIJ KERT, zemljak" marrying "FRANCIŠKA KOZINA, 1/2 zemljakova hči", his parents the late JOŽEF KERT, zemljak, and JERA JERALA, hers JOŽEF KOZINA, 1/2 zemljak, and MINA KODRAN; witnesses JANEZ JEŠE and ANTON PAPLER, both gruntar. SHE WAS UNDER TWENTY-FOUR and married on her father’s written consent of 5 February 1897, so she was born after about 1873. SHE IS NOT THE FRANZISKA KOZINA OF 1853, who died of measles at eleven in 1864; the two are forty years apart and this archive keeps them apart by their fathers. Nothing joins her to Johann Kozina’s house. Matricula, NSAL sig. 03919 image 60

rows.name: Urban Kozina
rows.relation: head of a SECOND Kozina farming household, a KMET - UNPLACED
rows.citation: Poročna knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1881-1899, book p.65 - at the marriage of ANTON ŽIHERL and MARIJA KOZINA in 1898 the bride’s parents are entered "URBAN KOZINA, KMET" and "MARIJANA GORJANC". KMET is a full peasant farmer. AND THE SAME ENTRY CARRIES TWO MORE KOZINA. The groom’s own mother is "MARIJANA KOZINA", already dead, wife of the late Urban Žiherl, kajžar - so a Kozina woman had married into the Žiherl house a generation earlier, and the 1898 marriage is cousins marrying or something near it. And the first witness is "JANEZ KOZINA, gruntarjev sin" - a farmer’s son, most likely the bride’s brother. FOUR KOZINA IN ONE ENTRY, none of them joined to this archive’s line by anything but the surname and the parish. Matricula, NSAL sig. 03919 image 66

rows.name: Marija Kozina, married Žiherl
rows.relation: DAUGHTER of Urban Kozina and Marijana Gorjanc - UNPLACED
rows.citation: Poročna knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1881-1899, book p.65 - "ANTON ŽIHERL, gruntar" marrying "MARIJA KOZINA, gruntarja hči", his parents the late URBAN ŽIHERL, kajžar, and the late MARIJANA KOZINA, hers URBAN KOZINA, kmet, and MARIJANA GORJANC; witnesses JANEZ KOZINA, gruntarjev sin, and ANTON BAJŽELJ, gruntar. HER HUSBAND’S MOTHER WAS ALSO A KOZINA, so she married into a house her own family had already married into once. THE THIRD AND LAST KOZINA BRIDE in the twenty-five years of this volume, and the only one of the three whose father is a full KMET. Nothing joins her to Johann Kozina of Zgornje Bitnje 9. Matricula, NSAL sig. 03919 image 66

rows.name: Joseph Kosina
rows.relation: infant of the house Martin was born in - almost certainly Johann and Lucia's son
rows.citation: Mrliška knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1836-1869 book p.33 - "1843, März · 27. gestorben · OBERFEICHTING · 9 · JOSEPH KOSINA, Häublers Sohn · katholisch · männlich · ALTER 2 Jahre · Halsentzündung". Born about 1841, DIED AT TWO, AT OBERFEICHTING 9 - the house Johann Kosina held as Häusler from 1833, where Martin was born in November 1841 and where Franz died in 1849. A HÄUBLER'S SON at that house in 1843 is Johann's son, and so a brother of ANTON 1834 and PETRUS 1836. NOT PROVED: this book names no parents. THE COUNT IS NOW SETTLED AND IT DOES NOT HELP HIM. On 27 September 2026 the whole K section of the 1832-1870 baptismal index (sig. 04632, images 246 and 247, entry 1 to entry 369, 1832 to 1870) was read end to end. It holds SIX Kozina and no more: Anton 1834 p.18 - Petrus 1836 p.33 - Martin 1841 p.64 - Francisca 1853 p.130 - Ana 1856 p.144 - MARIA 1859 p.159. The old count of five was short by one, and the one it had missed is MARIA 1859, not Joseph. THERE IS NO JOSEPH IN THAT INDEX. So either he was baptised outside the parish, or this index missed him the way the death index for the same years missed nine Kozina. The second is the likelier of the two on this archive’s own evidence, and neither is proved. Found by walking the register on 27 September 2026; THE INDEX DOES NOT LIST HIM. Matricula, NSAL sig. 00895 image 34

rows.name: Ursula Kosina
rows.relation: a Kosinar woman born about 1760 who had HELD a THIRD Oberfeichting house - UNPLACED
rows.citation: Mrliška knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1836-1869 book p.43 - "1845, März · 28. gestorben, 30. begraben · Ob. Feichting · 13 · URSCHULA KOSINA, ABNEHMERIN · katholisch · weiblich · ALTER 85 · Altersschwäche · versehen · idem". EIGHTY-FIVE, of old age, so BORN ABOUT 1760 - a generation above Franz (1775-76) and Matthäus (about 1774), and the second-oldest of the name this archive has reached after the Maria who died at 78 in 1816. AT OBERFEICHTING 13, which is neither Franz’s 9 nor Matthäus’s 14: a THIRD house of the name in one village. THE DATE, COMPLETED 27 September 2026: this row read "28th of a month in 1845 or 1846" for a day, because the month heading sits above the entry and had not been transcribed. The page was re-opened and read from its own head down. The printed year at the top of the column is 1845; the month headings run Jänner (29th), Februar (26th), MäRZ (2nd) - and from there the days run 2, 4, 6, 12, 13, 16, 18, 18, 25, 28, 30 without another heading, the last of them buried "1. April". HERS IS THE 28th, INSIDE MARCH. She died 28 MARCH 1845 and was buried on the 30th. AND THE WORD UNDER HER NAME IS NEW AND IT MATTERS: ABNEHMERIN, read at 10x. It is the female of Abnehmer and it is the same institution as the AUSNEHMER this register calls Franz at his death in 1849 and the AUSZÜGLERIN it calls Maria Dortschen at hers in 1841 - a householder who has HANDED THE HOUSE OVER and lives on the reserved portion. SO SHE HELD OBERFEICHTING 13 AND GAVE IT UP. She is not a lodger and not somebody’s widowed mother taken in: the third Kosina house in this village was HERS. That makes her a stronger candidate for the generation above Franz than the bare age did, and it still does not prove it - no parents, no husband, no children are named here. THE INDEX DOES NOT LIST HER. Matricula, NSAL sig. 00895 image 44

rows.name: Dorothea Kosiner recte Katzin
rows.relation: the third «Kosina» of 1813 - and the register says the family name is KATZIN
rows.citation: Krstna knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1812-1831 book p.8 - "6. [Hornung 1813] · 12 · DOROTHEA · katholisch · weiblich · ehelich · Vater: ANTON KOSINER RECTE KATZIN, Inwohner · Mutter: MARGARETH ZUBERTH". SHE IS THE "Kosina Dorothea - 8" the 1812-1831 baptismal index lists under 1813, and she closes the last of the two entries that file had open. THE ENTRY IS A WARNING, WHICH IS WHY SHE HAS A ROW. RECTE marks the LEGAL surname against the name a family is called by, so this household’s name is KATZIN and KOSINER is the by-name - almost certainly the house’s. A KOSINA IN THIS INDEX IS NOT ALWAYS A KOSINA IN THE FAMILY, and this archive has been counting index lines. The alternative reading, that the clerk meant the reverse, is not ruled out; RECTE is written plainly and the direction is the standard one. HER FATHER IS AN INWOHNER - a lodger - at house 12, which is the number Lukas Kosina’s household carries in 1818, so Anton may have been lodging with them; nothing here says so. NOTHING JOINS EITHER OF THEM TO FRANZ KOSINAR’S LINE. HOW SHE WAS FOUND, and it is the second time in one afternoon: this archive published twice that page 8 has no Kosina - once at 2.4x and once at 3.2x - and she is the third Dorothea on a page where two were seen. At 8x the column is plain. Matricula, NSAL sig. 00885 image 5, sig. 04631 image 169

rows.name: Marianna Kosina
rows.relation: DAUGHTER of Lukas Kosina - baptised 1813, dead at 26 - not in the tree
rows.place: baptised at house 27, died at Breg 12, župnija Kranj-Šmartin
rows.citation: DEATH: Mrliška knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1836-1869 book p.22 - "1840, Jänner · am 10. gestorben, am 12. begraben · BREG · 12 · MARIANNA KOSINA, Keuschlerstochter · katholisch · weiblich · ALTER 26 Jahre · Abzehrung · versehen". BAPTISM, FOUND 27 September 2026: Krstna knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1812-1831 book p.16 - "12. [August 1813] · Haus 27 · MARIANNA · katholisch · weiblich · ehelich · Vater: LUKAS KOSINER, Kaischler · Mutter: LUZIA O[K]LIN[T]SH". THE MATCH IS THREE THINGS AT ONCE. The age: baptised 12 August 1813, she was 26 years and five months on 10 January 1840, and the clerk wrote 26. The trade: she dies a KEUSCHLERSTOCHTER and her father is entered a KAISCHLER, which is the same word. And the index: the 1812-1831 baptismal index lists "Kosina Marianna - 16" under 1813, and this entry is on book page 16. NOT PROVED - the 1813 entry gives a house number and no village, so it cannot be tied to Breg, and no register yet read joins the two records directly. But it is no longer a guess. SHE IS LUKAS KOSINA’S DAUGHTER, and so a sister of the GERTRAUD he had in 1818 - the Gertraud this archive had to rule out before it could say Martin’s mother was the Gertraud of 1814. THE CORRECTION THIS COST: this archive published that page 16 had been opened and its whole father column read at 2.4x, and that THERE IS NO KOSINA ON IT. There is. Two and a half times magnification was not enough for this hand; at nine times the name is plain. Breg is a fourth Kosina settlement in the parish after Franz’s Oberfeichting 9, Matthäus’s 14 and Ursula’s 13, and she is still born the same year as Gertraud Kozina of Feichting, who lived to 1880 - a reminder that a name and a year together prove nothing. THE 1836-1869 DEATH INDEX DOES NOT LIST HER. Matricula, NSAL sig. 00895 image 23, sig. 00885 image 9, sig. 04631 image 169

rows.name: Franziska Kozina
rows.relation: DAUGHTER of Johann Kozina and Ursula Sedej - the archive had recorded her as a boy
rows.citation: BAPTISM, read 27 September 2026 on this row’s own instruction: Krstna knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1832-1870 book p.130 - "September 19. · Obr. Feichting · 9 · FRANCISCA · katholisch · ehelich · Vater: JOHANN KOZINA, Hüblar · Mutter: URSULA SEDEJ · Paten Johann Pevc and Marina Dolenc". THE SEX COLUMN, WHICH IS WHAT THIS ROW WAS OPENED FOR: the stroke stands in MÄDCHEN and the Knaben cell holds a dot. Read at 8x, and then checked a second way - the tick column was cropped from the printed heading down to her line and counted against all sixteen entries of the page, so the mark is placed by the column it sits under and not by eye. SHE IS A GIRL. DEATH: Mrliška knjiga 1836-1869 book p.140 - "1864, März · 7. gestorben, 9. begraben · OBERNFEICHTING · 9 · FRANZISKA KOZINA, Hüblersdochter · katholisch · weiblich · ALTER 11 Jahre · MASERN · A. Graf". Baptised 19 September 1853 and dead on 7 March 1864 is ten years and five months; the clerk’s 11 rounds up by seven, which is the ordinary slack of that column. THE CORRECTION: this archive recorded Johann’s child of 1853 as FRANZ, a son, and then asked whether the girl dying of measles in that house was a second child or the same one misread. She is the same one. There is no Franz. The index (sig. 04632, entry 213) writes the given name short and it can be read either way; the register writes FRANCISCA in full and ticks Mädchen. The death register had her right for eleven years before the baptismal register was asked. Her parents are named here for the first time - the death book named none. Matricula, NSAL sig. 00886 image 131, sig. 00895 image 141, sig. 04632 image 246

rows.name: Ana Kozina
rows.relation: DAUGHTER of Johann Kozina and Ursula Sedej - named by this archive, never dated
rows.citation: Krstna knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1832-1870 book p.144 - "Juli 25. · 25. · Ober do [Oberfeichting] · 9 · ANNA · katholisch · Mädchen · ehelich · Vater: JOHANN KOZINA, do. [Hüblar] · Mutter: URSULA SEDEJ". BORN AND BAPTISED THE SAME DAY, 25 JULY 1856, at Oberfeichting 9. This archive has carried her as "ANA 1856" since 21 September 2026 - a name taken from the index and never opened. The page was opened on 27 September 2026 while the K section was being counted, and it gives her the day, the house, the sex column and both parents. SHE IS THE MIDDLE OF THREE SISTERS: Franziska 1853, Anna 1856, Maria 1859, born to Johann and Ursula in six years in one cottage. She was seven when Franziska died of measles in that house and twelve when her father died in it. WHAT IS NOT KNOWN is what became of her: she is not in the 1836-1869 death register, which this archive walked in full, so she was alive in 1870. SHE DID NOT MARRY IN THIS PARISH, and that is now a walked negative rather than an absence of looking. On 27 September 2026 both marriage registers that could hold her were read: sig. 03918 (1856-1881) from image 58, which the year cells place at 1874 - the earliest she could marry - to the end of the volume, and sig. 03919 (1881-1899) IN FULL, all seventy-one openings. The groom’s and the bride’s surname columns were cropped from every opening and tiled five to a sheet. THERE ARE THREE KOZINA BRIDES IN THOSE TWENTY-FIVE YEARS and none of them is Anna: her sister MINA in 1883, FRANCIŠKA, daughter of Jožef Kozina, in 1897, and MARIJA, daughter of Urban Kozina, in 1898. So Anna either died unmarried outside the 1836-1869 death register this archive has walked, married in another parish, or left. Her death is not in 1836-1869; the volumes for 1870-1890 and 1890-1911 were read for Gertraud and gave one Kozina woman who is now identified as her sister, so ANNA IS IN NEITHER OF THOSE UNDER THE NAME KOZINA. Nothing further is known. Matricula, NSAL sig. 00886 image 145, sig. 04632 image 246, sig. 03918 images 58-94, sig. 03919 images 1-71

rows.name: Antonija Česen
rows.relation: DAUGHTER of Kancijan Česen and Marija Kozina - the third of their children to die
rows.citation: Mrliška knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1890-1911 book p.44, entry 23 - "1895, Februar · 26. umrla, 28. pokopana · STRAŽIŠČE · 84 · ANTONIJA ČESEN, hišarja hči · katoliške · ženskega · STAROST 1 1/2 LET · BOŽJAST · ni previdena". BORN ABOUT AUGUST 1893 and dead at eighteen months of the falling sickness, without the sacraments - which for an infant means it was quick. SHE IS NOT NAMED AS ANYBODY’S DAUGHTER IN THIS ENTRY, only "a cottager’s daughter" at house 84. The identification is the house and the surname: Stražišče 84 is where KANCIJAN ČESEN, hišar-dninar, and MARIJA roj. KOZINA lost Kancijan in 1892 and Pavla in 1893, and where Marija herself died on 2 April 1895. SHE DIED FIVE WEEKS BEFORE HER MOTHER, and she was conceived in the year her sister Pavla died. THREE CHILDREN AND THEN THE MOTHER, in one house in three years. Found on 27 September 2026 by re-walking the register for ČESEN after it had been walked for KOZINA and given nothing. Matricula, NSAL sig. 03917 image 45

rows.name: Maria Kozina of 1859
rows.relation: DAUGHTER of Johann Kozina and Ursula Sedej - a sister the archive did not have
rows.citation: Krstna knjiga Kranj-Šmartin 1832-1870 book p.159 - "August 7. · 7. · Oberfeichting · 9 · MARIA · katholisch · Mädchen · ehelich · Vater: JOHANN KOZINA, Hüblar · Mutter: URSULA SEDEJ · Paten Urbas Verčič and Marianna Berčič". BORN AND BAPTISED THE SAME DAY, 7 AUGUST 1859, at Oberfeichting 9 - Johann’s house, the house his father held before him and his nephew Martin was born in. She is Johann’s sixth known child and the third by Ursula Sedej, after Franziska 1853 and Ana 1856. HOW SHE WAS FOUND: not by looking for her. On 27 September 2026 the K section of the baptismal index for 1832-1870 was read end to end to settle a count, and she is entry 262 - "Maria Kozina - 159" - a name the archive had never carried. The count of FIVE Kozina baptisms in that volume was short by her. HER FATHER WAS SIXTY-ONE when she was born on this book’s own arithmetic - he died in 1868 aged 64 - so she was nine when she lost him, and her sister Franziska had died of measles in that house when she was four. WHAT IS NOT KNOWN is what became of her: she is not in the 1836-1869 death register, which this archive walked in full, so she was alive in 1870. AND WHAT BECAME OF HER IS NOW KNOWN, on the same day she was found. She married KANCIJAN ČESEN, a cottager’s son of STRAŽIŠČE 120, in the summer of 1883, aged 23 - and the marriage entry gives her residence as the RAILWAY STATION AT PODNART and her birthplace as "rojena v Zgornjem Bitnju št. 9", with her parents as JANEZ KOZINA, gruntar, and URŠA SEDEJ. SHE IS THEREFORE THE SAME WOMAN as the "Marija Kozina" this file carried as UNPLACED for six days - the only Kozina woman the archive found in twenty-five years of the 1890-1911 death register, known there only as the mother of two children who died at Stražišče 84 in 1892 and 1893. The two rows are one person and both now say so. Matricula, NSAL sig. 00886 image 160, sig. 04632 image 247, sig. 03919 image 15

rows.name: Niko Kalanj
rows.relation: son of Juro Kalanj and Ana, of Brinje house 231 - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga vjenčanih 1888-1899 (DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S), image 530 (left-hand page; page 74), entry no. 12 - married at Brinje on 16 (šesnajest) veljače 1890: "KALANJ NIKO", momak (bachelor), 48 years, born at Brinje house 231, son of KALANJ JURO and ANA, married the widow (udovica) "DRAŽANOVIĆ MARIJA", 33 years, born at Brinje house 198, daughter of VUČETIĆ IVAN and JANJA - the bride is entered under her married name Dražanović (the first pass read her as Vučić and gave the groom as 40 and the entry as no. 13: CORRECTED 5 October 2026 at close zoom: age 48, entry 12, month February, bride née VUČETIĆ), which agrees with the Marija VUČETIĆ who is the mother of Niko Kalanj's children Anica (1893) and Niko (1896) at house 231 (this file). Witnesses Zoričić Stjepan and Rumenović Tomo; officiated by the parish priest, signed "Šrobi Šimun". NOT IN THE TREE, AND NOT THE SAME GENERATION AS ANYONE PUBLISHED: the tree's Klenovica Kalanji begin on the coast with Petrus Kalanj and Magdalena Butković at house 22, born from the 1830s on. Niko, born about 1850, and his father JURO KALANJ, born perhaps the 1810s-1820s, are the first Kalanj men this archive has found actually resident at Brinje itself, independent of the bare parish name in the 1864 Klenovica baptism that first sent this archive looking. Whether Juro's family is an earlier generation of the same Klenovica line, or a separate Brinje branch, is not established.

NOT IN THE TREE: this archive's /kalanj/ page already names a Jure Borić of Brinje, from the 1910 Stipe Kalanj emigration papers, whose daughter Ana Borić married into the Papić family - this entry is the first independent confirmation from the parish register itself that Borić is a real, resident surname at Kamenica, with at least three men attested in 1890 (Luka, this groom, and Jozo). Whether any of them is kin to the Jure Borić already named on this archive's own page is not established.

rows.name: Niko Borić
rows.relation: SON OF NIKO BORIĆ AND MARIJA, of Brinje house 142 - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga vjenčanih 1888-1899 (DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S), image 538 (left-hand page; page 90), entry no. 28 - married at Brinje on 24 (dvadesetčetri) studenoga 1890: "BORIĆ NIKO", momak (bachelor), 25 years, born at Brinje house 142, a farmer of Brinje, SON OF BORIĆ NIKO AND MARIJA, married "BOŽEVIĆ MARIJA" (the surname is the Boležić/Božević of the births, read as Bašić by the first pass: CORRECTED 5 October 2026 at close zoom), djevojka (maiden), 22 years, born at Brinje house 105, daughter of BOŽEVIĆ MARKO and KATE. Witnesses BORIĆ JOZO and BORIĆ IVE (both Borić); officiant Šrobi Šimun. This is the marriage behind the Niko Borić x Boležić Marija household of houses 142/148 (Marko, Kate and the later children, this file); it gives Niko Borić (b. about 1865) a father Niko and a mother Marija, both Borić by surname. NOT IN THE TREE. A fourth Borić man found across images 530-538 of this one register, alongside Luka, Vid, Ivan, Juko and Miko (this file) — Borić is not a marginal surname at Brinje parish, it is one of the more frequent grooms' surnames in these forty-odd images alone.

rows.name: Marija Borić
rows.relation: DAUGHTER OF NIKO BORIĆ AND MARICA, of Brinje house 142 - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga vjenčanih 1888-1899 (DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S), image 564 (left-hand page; page 142), entry no. 13 of 1892 - married at Brinje on 21 (dvadesetjedan) siječnja 1892 (dated circa 1892-93 by the first pass; CORRECTED 5 October 2026, the entry stands in the 1892 numbering): bridegroom "HOFJEVAC NIKO", momak (bachelor), 29 years, born at Brinje house 154, son of HOFJEVAC PETAR and MARIJA; bride "BORIĆ MARIJA", djevojka (maiden), 18 years, born at Brinje house 142, a farmer of Brinje, DAUGHTER OF BORIĆ NIKO AND MARICA. Witnesses read Jelačić Tomo and Dražanović Ive; officiant Šrobi Šimun. NOT IN THE TREE. THE PUZZLE THE FIRST PASS RAISED IS ANSWERED: her father is Niko Borić of house 142, and the bachelor Niko Borić of house 142 who married Božević Marija on 24 November 1890 (image 538, this file) is the SON of a Niko Borić and a Marija - so two Niko Borić men, father and son, at house 142, and the bride of 1892 (born about 1873) is the groom's younger sister (the mother Marija/Marica of both entries is the same woman, the name read both ways). The Marija Borić wife of Niko Hofjevac of house 154 (Ive Hofjevac, 1899, this file) is this woman.

rows.name: Mijo Kalanj

Witnesses KALANJ MATE and Krnarić Franjo; officiant Šrobi Šimun. THE FATHER IS THE SAME 'KALANJ LJU-' AS IN THE MARRIAGE OF JURE KALANJ OF HOUSE 249 (19 November 1888, image 505, this file): Mijo and Jure are sons of the same man and woman at the same house, so brothers. THE DATE ENDS THE ANE KALANJ CONTRADICTION: Ane was born on 20 December 1892, ten months after this wedding. NOT IN THE TREE. A second Brinje address for the surname: Niko and Juro Kalanj (this file) are of house 231; Mijo, born about 1838 and the oldest-born Kalanj this archive has a year for, is of house 249, with a further Kalanj - Mate - standing witness. Three named Kalanj men now, across two houses, independent of the coastal Klenovica line the tree already holds. Whether either Brinje household connects to Josephus Kalanj, whose 1864 baptism first sent this archive to the parish, remains unestablished.

This is the surname the Gospić letter specifically asked this archive to find at Brinje, and it is now attested as a real, resident family rather than only a name in a letter.

rows.name: Luce Borić
rows.relation: daughter of Ivan/Ive Borić, of Brinje house 126 - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga vjenčanih 1888-1899 (DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S), image 595, entry no. 3 - "BORIĆ LUCE", widow, 27, of Brinje house 126, daughter of BORIĆ IVE and Mare, married Sertić Tove, bachelor, 28, of Brinje house 288. A witness on the same entry is BORIĆ JURO. NOT IN THE TREE. LIKELY SIBLING OF JUKO BORIĆ, STATED AS A LIKELIHOOD AND NOT ASSERTED: Juko Borić (this file, image 533) is recorded as son of "Borić Ivan" at the same Brinje house 126, marrying in 1890. "Ive" is the ordinary short form of "Ivan," and a shared house number this exact is not a coincidence this archive has seen elsewhere without it meaning something — but the two records do not name each other, and no baptism ties them together, so this stays a strong likelihood rather than a fact. NOT the same "Ive Borić" who married at Kamenica in July 1893 as son of Jozo Borić (this file, image 586) — that man cannot be a 27-year-old woman's father six months after his own first marriage; two different men named Ive Borić are now on record.

Kut" (the same hamlet read as Novi Kut for Marko Perković, this file), son of PERKOVIĆ MARKO and Luce, married Bublić Ruse, spinster, 26, of Plaščica. NOT IN THE TREE. NOT IN THE TREE. A SECOND WOMAN OF THIS EXACT NAME, KEPT SEPARATE FROM THE FIRST ON PURPOSE: this archive already holds a Marija Borić, spinster, 19, daughter of a Niko Borić, married Hofjenc Niko around 1892-93 (this file, image 564) — but that woman was of Brinje house 142 with a mother named Marta, married roughly five years earlier, and cannot be the same 19-year-old marrying here in November 1897 at Kamenica house 24 with a mother named Bare. Two different Niko Borić men, each with a daughter named Marija who married at 19, five years and one hamlet apart — read plainly as coincidence in a parish where both names are common, not forced into one identity.

rows.name: Ivo Borić

A SECOND Borić-marries-Borić household, distinct from the one already in this file at house 141 (Tome Borić and Jela Borić) - two different Brinje houses where the surname intermarried with itself, which is starting to look less like an isolated event and more like a real feature of how this surname sits in the parish. CORRECTION OF 5 OCTOBER 2026 ON THE FULL READABLE-ZOOM RE-READ OF IMAGE 106: this is the same entry (no. 87, born 12 and registered 13 September 1890), and read at readable scale it is 'BORIĆ VID', not Ivo, born at Brinje house 141, not 191, son of BORIĆ IVAN and BORIĆ MATIJA (given name read Matija), informants 'Rekić Marko i Borić Marica' (read Rebić or Rekić Marko). The house number 141 is therefore the house of the 1888 daughter Kate Borić (Ivan Borić x Marija Borić, house 141, image 42, this file): the same father Ivan, a mother named Marija/Matija Borić, the same house, two years apart, so the Ivan Borić household is two children deep (Kate 1888, Vid 1890) and its mother's name is Marija in 1888 and Matija in 1890 (probably one woman, the hand varying). The row keeps its original name and date under the earlier reading; the corrected child's name is Vid.

So this household, Frane Jurajić x Marija Borić of house 296, has THREE children on record: a girl of 1888 (read 'Vranić Ane', house 266, image 17), Marija (September 1889, image 67) and Juraj (1891), with house numbers 266 and 296 differing by one digit. It also bears on the open puzzle already logged for that Niko: a Marija Borić married out of house 142 around 1892-93 calling herself his daughter, which the ages never supported. A son born in September 1891 makes that impossibility sharper still - this Niko was raising an infant, not marrying off a grown daughter.

rows.name: Grgo Borić, witness at Brinje house 74 (1897)
rows.relation: witness to the baptism of Milaković Grgo's child, of Brinje house 74 - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga rođenih 1893-1897 (DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S), image 370, entry no. 27 - the baptism of "MILAKOVIĆ MANOLE", female, of Brinje house 74, daughter of Milaković Grgo and Lasić Kate, names "BORIĆ GRGO" as a witness alongside a woman named Marica. NOT IN THE TREE. A THIRD SIGHTING of this exact pairing: the same Borić Grgo witnessing a Milaković baptism at the very same house 74 where he first appeared in this file (image 239, 1893), and paired with a woman named Marica, the same name paired with him at image 335. Whether all three sightings are the same man, kept separate from the Grgo Borić already in this file as father of Stjepan and Ana Borić at house 126, is not established - but the recurrence of both the house number and the witness's companion's name is the strongest pattern of its kind in this file.

NOT IN THE TREE. A new Borić given name (Viol, also a Kalanj given name already in this file, though not shared by the same person) - kept on record despite the incomplete citation, since the witness name itself is legible and clear.

rows.relation: witness to the baptism of Blažanin Niko's child, of Brinje - not in the tree
