NOT IN THE TREE. Kept separate from the Niko Borić already in this file (married 1890, house 142) and from the two households already in this file fathered by a Niko Borić (house 148; Kamenica house 24), since nothing ties any of them together beyond the shared given name.

rows.name: Marica Borić, daughter of Niko Borić (house 142)
rows.relation: daughter of Niko Borić and Bojenić Marica, of Brinje house 142 - a probable third child of this household - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga rođenih (third item on the same film as DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S, continuing past 1897 with entry numbers unbroken), image 427, entry no. 70 - "BORIĆ MARICA", female, born 23 July 1898, of Brinje house 142, daughter of BORIĆ NIKO and BOJENIĆ MARICA. Witnesses (porodično i rodno ime prijavitelja) "BORIĆ TOME" i Hofjevac Marija. NOT IN THE TREE. A PROBABLE THIRD CHILD of the Niko Borić already in this file at house 142 (married 1890 to a wife recorded as Bašić Marija; first child Viol born 1891 to a wife recorded as Bošnjić Marica) - the mother's maiden name is entered a third way here, Bojenić, close enough in sound to Bašić/Bošnjić that all three may be the same woman under three scribal readings, or may not be; not merged, only noted. The witness BORIĆ TOME is kept separate from the Tome Borić already in this file as a lone 1893 witness at house 101 and from the Tome Borić heading his own household at Kamenica house 23, since nothing here ties any of them together. SECOND READING AT CLOSE ZOOM, 5 OCTOBER 2026 (image 427, left-hand page, second entry; page 44): the entry is headed 24 (srpnja) July 1898 and says born 22 July, so the first pass's 23 July should read 22 JULY (born) and 24 July (registered); the mother's surname is written BOŽEŠIĆ (read Boležić or Bolešić), her given name Marica, the same woman as the Marija Boležić of the Marko Borić entry (image 266, 1894) and the Kate Borić entry (image 341, 1896) - the household is Borić Niko x Boležić Marija/Marica, house 142 or 148, and this is its THIRD child on record. A margin note (a notification of the Križpolje registry, 1964) says she died on 27 October 1964 at a place read as Kroparni, entered 4 November 1964. The informants are 'Borić Tome i Hofjevac Marija'.

rows.name: Borić France, wife of Sertić Jure
rows.relation: mother of Sertić Niko, of Kamenica house 28 - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga rođenih (third item on the same film as DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S, entries now numbering within calendar year 1898 rather than continuing the running count from item two), image 431, entry no. 86 - "SERTIĆ NIKO", male, born 10 October 1898, of Kamenica house 28, son of SERTIĆ JURE and BORIĆ FRANCE (an unusual given name, read as written). Witnesses "BORIĆ VUJO" and Sertić Ruže. NOT IN THE TREE. A NEW Sertić-Borić couple, kept separate from the Sertić Jure and Tauka Borić already in this file at Kamenica house 13 (parents of Ivan, born 1893, and Niko, born 1896) - a different house number and a different given name for the Borić wife, though the shared given name Jure for both Sertić husbands is left unexplained: possibly the same man with two households, possibly two different men, not established. SECOND READING AT CLOSE ZOOM, 5 OCTOBER 2026 (image 431, left-hand page, second entry; page 52): the entry is headed 14 (kolovoza) AUGUST 1898 and says born 10 AUGUST, not October; the house reads Kamenica 29 (28 in the first pass); the informants are 'Borić Vijo i Sertić Ruže' (Vijo Borić is the father of the Borić Marija entries of 1895 and 1898, this file). Ten days later (20 August 1898) a Jure Sertić and BORIĆ TANKA have a son Franjo at Kamenica 13 (this file): either a confusion of Franca and Tanka by the clerk, or two Jure Sertić households each with a Borić wife; not settled.

rows.name: Borić Vujo, witness at Kamenica house 28
rows.relation: witness to the baptism of Sertić Niko, of Kamenica - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga rođenih (third item on the same film as DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S), image 431, entry no. 86 - the baptism of "SERTIĆ NIKO", male, of Kamenica house 28, son of Sertić Jure and Borić France, names "BORIĆ VUJO" as a witness alongside Sertić Ruže. NOT IN THE TREE. A new Borić given name (Vujo), kept separate from all other Borić individuals already in this file since nothing ties him to any of them. SECOND READING AT CLOSE ZOOM, 5 OCTOBER 2026: the baptism is of 14 AUGUST 1898 (born 10 August), not October; the name reads 'Borić Vijo' (Vijo, as in Borić Vijo x Sertić Ane of house 126/186, this file), the entry's house is Kamenica 29.

rows.name: Manole Borić, daughter of Alojz Borić
rows.relation: daughter of Alojz Borić and Mesić Manola, of Kamenica house 23 - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga rođenih (third item on the same film as DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S, entries now numbering within calendar year 1899), image 449, entry no. 4 - "BORIĆ MANOLE", female, born 3 January 1899, of Kamenica house 23, daughter of BORIĆ ALOJZ and MESIĆ MANOLA. Witnesses (unclear surname) Joso and Femić Marija, matičar Sertić Šimun. NOT IN THE TREE. THIS BEARS DIRECTLY ON TWO PUZZLES ALREADY IN THIS FILE: the same house number, Kamenica 23, already holds Tome Borić (born 1895) son of Borić Tome and Mesić Manda-Marija - a different father's given name but the same house and the same wife's surname, Mesić, for a second time. And ALOJZ BORIĆ himself was already in this file only as a plausible, unconfirmed witness sighting (image 338, circa 1895) tentatively linked to LOJZE BORIĆ of Kamenica house 83 (father of Luce Borić, whose mother was also a Mesić - Manda-Marija). This baptism proves Alojz Borić is a real household head, not merely a witness, but does not by itself resolve whether he is the same man as Tome of house 23, the same man as Lojze of house 83, both, or neither - three Borić men, three readings of a name, two houses, and a wife's surname (Mesić) that keeps recurring, none of it merged here.

rows.name: Ruže Kalanj, daughter of Jure Kalanj (house 231)
rows.relation: daughter of Jure Kalanj and Vučetić Manole, of Brinje house 231 - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga rođenih (third item on the same film as DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S, entries numbering within calendar year 1899), image 450, entry no. 5 - "KALANJ RUŽE", female, born 5 January and registered 8 January 1899, of Brinje house 231, daughter of KALANJ JURE and VUČETIĆ MANOLE. Witnesses Rumenović Jure i Ruce, matičar Sertić Šimun. NOT IN THE TREE. CORRECTED ON RE-READING AT FULL ZOOM, 5 October 2026: the mother's surname was first read as Vukelić and is in fact VUČETIĆ - the same surname as Marija Vučetić, wife of the Niko Kalanj already on record at this same house 231. NOT MERGED, but the link is now a real one: a Kalanj father named Jure (a variant of Juro, the name of Niko's own father) and a Vučetić mother at the very house where Niko Kalanj and Marija Vučetić raised Anica (1893) and Niko (1896). Whether Jure is the same man as Niko under a different given name, a brother who married a Vučetić woman too, or the same Marija Vučetić under a variant given name (Manole) is not established. See also Franc Kalanj, born 28 January 1899 at the same house (this file), whose parents are entered as Kalanj Mile and Vučetić Marija - two Kalanj births at house 231 within four weeks cannot be one child. SURNAME QUESTION SETTLED 5 OCTOBER 2026: the 'Kalauj' near-miss this register's earlier reading kept separate is the same word as Kalanj; the 1891 entry for Marija/Marisa (image 157, this file) names these same parents, Jure Kalanj and Vučetić Manole, at this same house 231. This row is Kalanj without caveat.

rows.name: Luce Borić, daughter of Tome Borić (house 141)
rows.relation: daughter of Tome Borić and Jela Borić, of Brinje house 141 - a fifth child of that household - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga rođenih (third item on the same film as DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S, entries numbering within calendar year 1899), image 450, entry no. 8 - "BORIĆ LUCE", female, born 19 January 1899 and registered 30 January, of Brinje house 141, daughter of BORIĆ TOME and BORIĆ JELA. Witnesses "BORIĆ NIKO" and Radotić Luce, matičar Sertić Šimun. NOT IN THE TREE. A FIFTH CHILD of the Borić-marries-Borić household at house 141 already in this file (Juraj, 1888; Petar, 1890; Matija, 1892; Ove, 1894) - the same house number and both parents' names, eleven years after the first child. Separate from the Marica daughter of Ive Borić and Matija Borić entered at this same house in 1895, whose parents' names differ. Kept apart from the several other women named Luce Borić already in this file (Kamenica house 24, Kamenica house 83, wife of Marko Bišanić, the widow of house 126) since nothing ties them together beyond the name. The witness Borić Niko is not tied to any of the Niko Borić men already here (houses 142, 148, Kamenica 24, witness at house 154).

rows.name: Franc Kalanj, son of Mile Kalanj and Vučetić Marija
rows.relation: son of Mile Kalanj and Vučetić Marija, of Brinje house 231 - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga rođenih (third item on the same film as DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S, entries numbering within calendar year 1899), image 451, entry no. 11 - "KALANJ FRANC", male, born 28 January 1899 and registered 29 January, of Brinje house 231, son of KALANJ MILE and VUČETIĆ MARIJA. Witnesses Buhlić Franc i Marija, matičar Vučetić Stipe. NOT IN THE TREE. THE SAME HOUSE AND THE SAME MOTHER'S NAME AS THE NIKO KALANJ HOUSEHOLD ALREADY ON RECORD: Niko Kalanj married in 1890 a widow Marija and lived at Brinje house 231; their children Anica (1893) and Niko (1896) name the mother as Marija Vučetić. This birth names the same house and the same woman's name, but the father's given name reads Mile (clear M, no Niko-like stroke) where Niko would be expected, and a Kalanj Jure with a Vučetić Manole had a daughter at this house three weeks earlier (this file). Kept as a separate entry rather than folded into Niko's household; most likely a continuation of that family, possibly with the father's name misentered or a second Kalanj brother sharing the house and marrying into the same Vučetić family, but neither is established.

rows.name: Mijo Krnarić, son of Jure Krnarić and Marija Borić
rows.relation: son of Jure Krnarić and Borić Marija, of Brinje house 208 - a third child of that household - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga rođenih (third item on the same film as DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S, entries numbering within calendar year 1899), image 454, entry no. 23 - "KRNARIĆ MIJO", male, born and registered 20 March 1899, of Brinje house 208, son of KRNARIĆ JURE and BORIĆ MARIJA. Witnesses entered as "Perkić Mijo" (the recurring near-miss surname, distinct from Perković) and a second name read as Petrović Manda, matičar Sertić Šimun. NOT IN THE TREE. A THIRD CHILD of the Krnarić-Borić household already in this file (Manda, born 24 May 1894, and Tome, born 18 March 1897) - the same two parents' names, and the same house number, 208, as the 1897 birth. This also steadies the second Krnarić household entered at house 208 in November 1898 (Franjo Krnarić and Javor Marija, image 445 - not in this file as it names no Borić), which now looks like a second family sharing the house rather than a rival reading of this one.

rows.name: Marija Kalanj, daughter of Viol Kalanj
rows.relation: daughter of Viol Kalanj and Zoričić Kate, of Brinje house 188 - a third child of that household - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga rođenih (third item on the same film as DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S, entries numbering within calendar year 1899), image 454, entry no. 24 - "KALANJ MARIJA", female, born 13 March 1899 and registered 16 March, of Brinje house 188, daughter of KALANJ VIOL and ZORIČIĆ KATE. Witnesses Draženović Joso i Manok, matičar Sertić Šimun. NOT IN THE TREE. A THIRD CHILD of the Viol Kalanj and Kate Zoričić household already in this file (Kate, December 1890, house 118; Franjo, August 1893, house 189) - the same two parents' names, eight years after the second. The house number is a third variant, 188, beside 118 and 189: all three are read as written, and a house number that drifts by one digit across three births to the same parents is probably a scribal habit in the register rather than three addresses. Kept separate from the several women named Marija Kalanj in the tree.

rows.name: Bare Hofjevac, daughter of Hofjevac Viol and Marija Borić
rows.relation: daughter of Hofjevac Viol (earlier read Vid) and Borić Marija, of Brinje house 160 - a second child of that household - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga rođenih (third item on the same film as DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S, entries numbering within calendar year 1899), image 461, entry no. 51 - "HOFJEVAC BARE", female, born 9 August and registered 10 August 1899, of Brinje house 160, daughter of HOFJEVAC VIOL and BORIĆ MARIJA. Witnesses Hofjevac Marko i Bare, matičar Vučetić Stipe; later marginal notes in a twentieth-century hand. NOT IN THE TREE. A SECOND CHILD of the household already in this file as Marija Borić, wife of Vid Hofjevac (Hofjevac Tome, born 3 January 1895, house 160): the same house number and the same mother. The father's given name is entered here as Viol where the 1895 entry was read as Vid - the two short forms are close enough in this hand that one man under two readings is the natural explanation, not asserted. This is the same eighth Marija Borić already in this file, not a new woman.

rows.name: Kate Borić, wife of Petar Sertić
rows.relation: mother of Sertić Tomo, of Brinje house 128 - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga rođenih (third item on the same film as DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S, entries numbering within calendar year 1899), image 461, entry no. 52 - "SERTIĆ TOMO", male, born 7 August and registered 13 August 1899, of Brinje house 128, son of SERTIĆ PETAR and BORIĆ KATE. Witnesses Jelačić Tomo i BORIĆ JELA, matičar Vučetić Stipe. NOT IN THE TREE. A fifth woman named Kate Borić in this file, kept apart from the Kate Borić who was a witness at house 85, the unmarried mother at Kamenica, the wife of Joso Domić at Lučane and the Kate of Kamenica house 24, since nothing ties any of them together beyond the name. Sertić is the surname Borić women are found marrying into most often in this file: Luce Borić (widow, married Sertić Tove, Brinje 288, 1894), Tauka (Kamenica 13), Marija (married Sertić Tave, Kamenica 13, 1897), France (Kamenica 28) and now Kate (Brinje 128).

rows.name: Jela Borić, witness at Brinje house 128
rows.relation: witness to the baptism of Sertić Tomo, of Brinje - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga rođenih (third item on the same film as DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S, entries numbering within calendar year 1899), image 461, entry no. 52 - the baptism of "SERTIĆ TOMO", male, of Brinje house 128, son of Sertić Petar and Borić Kate, names "BORIĆ JELA" as a witness alongside Jelačić Tomo. NOT IN THE TREE. A witness only. The only Borić woman called Jela already in this file is the mother of the house-141 Borić-marries-Borić household (Tome Borić and Jela Borić); this may be her standing up for a Borić relative's child, but nothing in the entry says so and she is not merged with her.

rows.name: Joso Borić, son of Stipe Borić and Luce Sertić
rows.relation: son of Borić Stipe and Sertić Luce, of Kamenica house 23 - a third Borić household at that house number - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga rođenih (third item on the same film as DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S, entries numbering within calendar year 1899), image 462, entry no. 55 - "BORIĆ JOSO", male, born 18 August and registered 20 August 1899, of Kamenica house 23, son of BORIĆ STIPE and SERTIĆ LUCE (both entered as of Kamenica). Witnesses Blažanin Šime i Marija. Later marginal notes dated 1924 and 1982 record his own later civil events (not fully read). NOT IN THE TREE. KAMENICA HOUSE 23 NOW HOLDS THREE BORIĆ FATHERS IN THIS FILE: Tome Borić (son Tome, 1895, wife Mesić Manda-Marija), Alojz Borić (daughter Manole, January 1899, wife Mesić Manola) and now Stipe Borić (this child, wife Sertić Luce). The wives differ (Mesić, Mesić, Sertić), so these read as three households sharing one house number - the same shape already seen at Kamenica house 24 - rather than one man under three names; but Stipe and the Borić Stjepan who witnessed a Sertić baptism at Kamenica house 5 in 1895 (this file) may be one man, which is a plausible, unconfirmed link and not a merge. Another Borić man marrying a Sertić woman: Sertić is again the partner surname.

rows.name: Kate Borić, wife of Marko Sertić
rows.relation: mother of Sertić Ruže, of Brinje house 127 - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga rođenih (third item on the same film as DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S, entries numbering within calendar year 1899), image 462, entry no. 53 - "SERTIĆ RUŽE", female, born 13 August and registered 15 August 1899, of Brinje house 127, daughter of SERTIĆ MARKO and BORIĆ KATE. Witnesses Jurašić Jure i Mesić Ovca, matičar Vučetić Stipe. NOT IN THE TREE. A SIXTH KATE BORIĆ, AND A PUZZLE STATED RATHER THAN SMOOTHED: the baptism immediately before this one in the register (entry 52, born 7 August, Brinje house 128, this file) names a mother Borić Kate married to Sertić PETAR; this one, six days later at house 127, names a mother Borić Kate married to Sertić MARKO. Two different husbands, two neighbouring house numbers, one mother's name and surname, within a week - two different women both called Kate Borić who married into Sertić, or one woman and a scribal slip on the husband's name or the house. Not resolved, and not guessed at; the two rows are kept separate.

rows.name: Lojze Borić, witness at Kamenica house 5
rows.relation: witness to the baptism of Sertić Marko, of Kamenica house 5 - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga rođenih (third item on the same film as DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S, entries numbering within calendar year 1899), image 462, entry no. 54 - the baptism of "SERTIĆ MARKO", male, born and registered 18 August 1899, of Kamenica house 5, son of Sertić Pave and Vučetić Marica, names "BORIĆ LOJZE" as a witness alongside a woman read as Anica (surname not given). NOT IN THE TREE. A witness only. "Lojze" is the short form of Alojz and is the name of the father of Luce Borić at Kamenica house 83 (this file, 1894); the same hamlet, a Sertić baptism, and a name already tied to Alojz Borić of Kamenica house 23 (this file, January 1899) make this a plausible, unconfirmed sighting of that same man - not merged. Kamenica house 5 is also the house where Borić Stjepan witnessed a Sertić baptism in 1895 (this file).

rows.name: Tome Borić, son of Tome Borić and Radotić Marija (Kamenica house 24)
rows.relation: son of Tome Borić and Radotić Marija, of Kamenica house 24 - a later child of that household - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga rođenih (third item on the same film as DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S, entries numbering within calendar year 1899), image 468, entry no. 79 - "BORIĆ TOME", male, born 13 and registered 14 September 1899, of Kamenica house 24, son of BORIĆ TOME and RADOTIĆ MARIJA. Witnesses Radotić Niko i Rajković Kate, matičar Sertić Šimun; a later marginal note of the 1960s. NOT IN THE TREE. THIS SETTLES A LITTLE OF THE KAMENICA HOUSE-24 PUZZLE: the file already holds Luce Borić, born October 1893 at house 24, daughter of Borić Tome and Radotić Marija - a father named Tome and a mother named Radotić Marija, not the Niko Borić and Bare or Dace named for the other children at that house. This child, six years later, has the same father's name, the same mother's name and the same house, so a Tome Borić x Radotić Marija household at house 24 is now two children deep and reads as a real, separate household beside the Niko Borić one, not a scribal slip for it. Kept apart from the Tome Borić of Kamenica house 23 (wife Mesić Manda-Marija) and from the Tome Borić of Brinje house 141 (wife Jela Borić) - three Borić men called Tome, each with his own wife.

rows.name: Niko Kalanj, witness at Plašćica 4
rows.relation: witness to the baptism of Buhlić Ivan, of Plašćica - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga rođenih (third item on the same film as DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S, entries numbering within calendar year 1899), image 472, entry no. 94 - the baptism of "BUHLIĆ IVAN", male, born 28 September and registered 1 October 1899, of Plašćica 4, son of Buhlić Franjo and Murat Marija, names "KALANJ NIKO" as a witness alongside Murat Ruže. NOT IN THE TREE. A witness only. The surname reads Kalanj; the Kalauj/Kalanj doubt that this row once carried was settled on 5 October 2026 (see Marija Kalanj, daughter of Jure Kalanj, 1891, this file): Kalauj is Kalanj. The given name Niko is the name of Niko Kalanj of Brinje house 231 (married 1890, this file), who may be standing witness at a neighbouring hamlet's baptism; that is a plausible, unconfirmed link, not a merge.

rows.name: Ive Hofjevac, son of Niko Hofjevac and Marija Borić (house 154)
rows.relation: son of Hofjevac Niko and Borić Marija, of Brinje house 154 - a later child of that household - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga rođenih (third item on the same film as DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S, entries numbering within calendar year 1899), image 474, entry no. 104 - "HOFJEVAC IVE", male, born 12 and registered 15 November 1899, of Brinje house 154, son of HOFJEVAC NIKO and BORIĆ MARIJA. Witnesses Jelačić Niko i BORIĆ MILKA, matičar Vučetić Stipe. NOT IN THE TREE. A LATER CHILD of the household already in this file: the 1892-93 marriage of Marija Borić (daughter of Niko Borić of house 142) to Hofjenc Niko of Brinje house 154, and their son Niko, born 11 October 1893 (this file) - the same father's name, the same mother's maiden surname and name, and the same house number, 154, as the marriage groom's. Six years after the first child; the spelling is Hofjevac here, as at house 160, but the husband's given name and the house number tie this to the house-154 couple and not to the Vid/Viol Hofjevac of house 160 (Marija Borić number eight), whose own second child was born in August of the same year.

rows.name: Milka Borić, witness at Brinje house 154
rows.relation: witness to the baptism of Hofjevac Ive, of Brinje - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga rođenih (third item on the same film as DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S, entries numbering within calendar year 1899), image 474, entry no. 104 - the baptism of "HOFJEVAC IVE", male, of Brinje house 154, son of Hofjevac Niko and Borić Marija, names "BORIĆ MILKA" (given name read as Milka, not fully certain) as a witness alongside Jelačić Niko. NOT IN THE TREE. A new Borić given name, a witness only, plausibly a relative of the child's mother Marija Borić standing up for her child, though the entry does not say so; not tied to any Borić household in this file.

rows.name: Matija Borić, wife of Stipo Mesić (Kamenica 20, 1899)
rows.relation: mother of Mesić Petar, of Kamenica house 20 - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga rođenih (third item on the same film as DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S, entries numbering within calendar year 1899), image 475, entry no. 105 - "MESIĆ PETAR", male, born and registered 14 November 1899, of Kamenica house 20, son of MESIĆ STIPO and BORIĆ MATIJA (the mother's given name is Matija at readable zoom, not Marija as the first pass read it, and agrees with the Mesić Stjepan x Borić Matija household of Kamenica house 10, whose daughter Ruže was born in January 1898, this file: probably the same couple, the house number written 10 and 20; not merged). Witnesses read as Perkić Mijo (the recurring near-miss surname, distinct from Perković) i BORIĆ MARIJA, matičar Sertić Šimun. NOT IN THE TREE. A Borić woman married out of the surname into Mesić - a surname that already appears as the maiden name of the wives of Lojze, Tome and Alojz Borić at Kamenica, so Borić and Mesić are now married to each other in both directions at Kamenica. Kept apart from the other Borić women in this file since nothing ties them together beyond the name.

rows.name: Marija Borić, witness at Kamenica house 20
rows.relation: witness to the baptism of Mesić Petar, of Kamenica - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga rođenih (third item on the same film as DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S, entries numbering within calendar year 1899), image 475, entry no. 105 - the baptism of "MESIĆ PETAR", male, of Kamenica house 20, son of Mesić Stipo and Borić Matija, names "BORIĆ MARIJA" as a witness alongside a man read as Perkić Mijo. NOT IN THE TREE. A witness only. She stands up for a child whose mother is Borić Matija (corrected from the first pass's Marija on 5 October 2026): a relative of the mother is the natural reading, but the entry does not say so and the two women are not merged.

rows.name: Luce Borić, wife of Pave Sertić
rows.relation: mother of Sertić Manole, of Brinje house 289 - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga rođenih (third item on the same film as DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S, entries numbering within calendar year 1899), image 478, entry no. 120 - "SERTIĆ MANOLE", female, born 29 October and registered 1 November 1899, of Brinje house 289, daughter of SERTIĆ PAVE and BORIĆ LUCE. Witnesses Hofjevac Niko i BORIĆ MILKA, matičar Vučetić Stipe. NOT IN THE TREE. A sixth woman named Luce Borić in this file, and the sixth Borić woman found married into Sertić (after Luce at Brinje 288 in 1894, Tauka, Marija, France and the two Kates of August 1899). The widow Luce Borić of house 126 married Sertić Tove at Brinje house 288 in 1894 (this file) - a house next door to this one, 289, and a Sertić husband, though the husband's given name here is Pave, not Tove; whether this is her under a different reading of the husband's name, a younger Luce, or another woman is not established and not guessed at. Kept separate from all five other Luce Borić women in this file.

rows.name: Milka Borić, witness at Brinje house 289
rows.relation: witness to the baptism of Sertić Manole, of Brinje - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga rođenih (third item on the same film as DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S, entries numbering within calendar year 1899), image 478, entry no. 120 - the baptism of "SERTIĆ MANOLE", female, of Brinje house 289, daughter of Sertić Pave and Borić Luce, names "BORIĆ MILKA" as a witness alongside Hofjevac Niko. NOT IN THE TREE. THE SAME NAME TWO WEEKS BEFORE ANOTHER SIGHTING: on 15 November 1899 a Borić Milka stood witness at Brinje house 154 beside Jelačić Niko at the baptism of Hofjevac Ive, son of Hofjevac Niko and Marija Borić (this file); here, on 1 November, she stands beside Hofjevac Niko himself. The two sightings are close enough in time, and share Hofjevac Niko closely enough, to read as one woman - probably a kinswoman of Marija Borić, Niko Hofjevac's wife - but the register does not say so and the two rows are not merged.

rows.name: Manole Kalanj, daughter of Jerko Kalanj and Krnarić Ruže
rows.relation: daughter of Kalanj Jerko (given name read Jerok) and Krnarić Ruže, of Brinje house 188 - a second Kalanj household at that house number - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga rođenih (third item on the same film as DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S, entries numbering within calendar year 1899), image 481, entry no. 131 - "KALANJ MANOLE", female, born 11 and registered 13 November 1899, of Brinje house 188, daughter of KALANJ JEROK (Jerko) and KRNARIĆ RUŽE. Witnesses Bišanić Jerok i Dubčić Manda (surname read with some doubt), matičar Sertić Šimun. NOT IN THE TREE. A NEW KALANJ FATHER: Jerko, not Viol, Niko, Jure, Mile, Mijo or Mate, as the Kalanj men in this file are named. House 188 is where this file already places Marija Kalanj, born 13 March 1899 to Kalanj Viol and Zoričić Kate (this file) - a different father and a different mother, eight months apart, at the same house number: two Kalanj households sharing house 188, the same shape this file keeps meeting with Borić households at Kamenica 23 and 24. The surname here reads Kalanj clearly in this hand, and the mother's Krnarić is one of the surnames Borić women also marry into. Not merged with the Viol Kalanj household.

rows.name: Stipe Kalanj, son of Mijo Kalanj and Krnarić Manda
rows.relation: son of Kalanj Mijo and Krnarić Manda, of Brinje house 249 - the first child on record of that marriage - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga rođenih (third item on the same film as DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S, entries numbering within calendar year 1899), image 483, entry no. 137 - "KALANJ STIPE", male, born 18 and registered 20 November 1899, of Brinje house 249, son of KALANJ MIJO and KRNARIĆ MANDA. Witnesses Vučetić Stipe i KALANJ LUCE, matičar Vučetić Stipe. Later marginal notes of 1982-83 record the child's own later civil events (not fully read). NOT IN THE TREE. THE CHILD OF A MARRIAGE ALREADY IN THIS FILE: Mijo Kalanj, widower, 53, of Brinje house 249, married Krnarić Manole (Manoš), spinster, 23, daughter of Krnarić Joso of house 168, on 15 February 1892 (marriage book, image 566, this file) - the same two parents' names, the same house, seven years on. Mijo would be about 60 at this birth; the file's earlier note gives him as born about 1838, so he is an old father but not an impossible one. TWO THINGS FOLLOW. First, the house number 249 is also where this archive logged a Kalauj Jure and Vučetić Ove/Manole in 1892 (image 171) as a distinct near-miss family: a house that holds a Kalanj bachelor of 55 in 1893 and a Kalanj baby in 1899 also holds a 'Kalauj' household in between, which is a point in favour of reading that household as Kalanj, and is recorded here as such a point and not as a reclassification. Second, the witness KALANJ LUCE is a Kalanj woman not otherwise known to this file, probably a kinswoman of Mijo. NOT merged with any other Kalanj household. RE-READ AT CLOSE ZOOM ON 5 OCTOBER 2026 (image 483, left-hand page, first entry; page 156): the mother's given name is written MANOLE, not Manda (the marriage book names the bride Manoš/Manda, the earlier 1892 birth Manole: all spellings of one woman are plausible, none is certain), the house number reads 249, and the margin carries two later civil notes of 1982 and 1983. The informants line reads 'Vučetić Stipe i Kalanj Luca'.

rows.name: Luce Kalanj, witness at Brinje house 249
rows.relation: witness to the baptism of Kalanj Stipe, of Brinje - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga rođenih (third item on the same film as DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S, entries numbering within calendar year 1899), image 483, entry no. 137 - the baptism of "KALANJ STIPE", male, of Brinje house 249, son of Kalanj Mijo and Krnarić Manda, names "KALANJ LUCE" as a witness alongside Vučetić Stipe. NOT IN THE TREE. A witness only - a first Kalanj woman named Luce in this file (read as Kalanj; the Kalanj/Kalauj doubt is settled, they are the same); at the house of Mijo Kalanj, so most likely a relative of the child's father standing up for him.

rows.name: Marija Kalanj, witness at Brinje house 228
rows.relation: witness to the baptism of Murat Jure, of Brinje - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga rođenih (third item on the same film as DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S, entries numbering within calendar year 1899), image 485, entry no. 148 - the baptism of "MURAT JURE", male, born 17 and registered 20 December 1899, of Brinje house 228, son of Murat Jure and Rajković Marija, names "KALANJ MARIJA" as a witness alongside a Petrović Ove (surname read with some doubt). NOT IN THE TREE. A witness only, the Kalanj/Kalauj doubt once carried here is settled (Kalauj is Kalanj, 5 October 2026). The given name Marija is that of Marija Vučetić, wife of Niko Kalanj of house 231 (this file), and of the Marija of the 1899 Vučetić-mother Kalanj entries at that house; whether this is that woman standing witness at another household is a plausible, unconfirmed link, not a merge.

rows.name: Manole Borić, daughter of Grgo Borić and Marija Milaković (house 126)
rows.relation: daughter of Grgo Borić and Milaković Marija, of Brinje house 126 - a third child of that household - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga rođenih (third item on the same film as DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S, entries running to the end of the 1899 sequence and booked on 1 January), image 487, entry no. 155 - "BORIĆ MANOLE", female, born 30 December 1899 and registered 1 January (year written as 1899 in the entry, most likely 1900 by the date), of Brinje house 126, daughter of BORIĆ GRGO and MILAKOVIĆ MARIJA. Witnesses Blažanin Viol i Manola, matičar Vučetić Stipe. NOT IN THE TREE. A THIRD CHILD of the Grgo Borić and Marija Milaković household already in this file (Stjepan, born August 1893; Ana, born 25 December 1894), at the same house number, 126, and with both parents' names exactly as before - five years after the last child. This is the steadiest Grgo Borić household in the file, and the one that carries the Borić Grgo witness at house 74 (this file) only by the shared given name; whether those men are the same is still not established. The father is entered as Grgo, not Ivan or Ive, so the Ivan/Ive Borić of house 126 (father of Juko and the widow Luce, this file) is again not this man's household. Kept apart from the other Manole Borić in this file (daughter of Alojz Borić, house 23).

rows.name: Pave Kalanj, son of Viol Kalanj and Kate Zoričić
rows.relation: son of Viol Kalanj and Zoričić Kate, of Brinje house 188 - the second child of that household, missed on the first pass - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga rođenih 1888-1900 (DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S), image 163, entry no. 9 - "KALANJ PAVE", male, born 14 January and registered 17 January 1892, of Brinje house 188, son of KALANJ VIOL and ZORIČIĆ KATE. Witnesses Perkić Mijo (the recurring near-miss) i Dražanović Manda, matičar Sertić Šimun. NOT IN THE TREE. FOUND ON 5 OCTOBER 2026 WHILE SETTLING THE KALAUJ QUESTION: this entry was read at the time as a Kalauj near-miss and so never recorded. It is a clear Kalanj in a clean hand, and it is the missing middle child of the Viol Kalanj x Zoričić Kate household already in this file - Kate (December 1890, house 118), PAVE (January 1892, house 188), Franjo (August 1893, house 189) and Marija (March 1899, house 188) - and it shows the house number 188 belongs to this household from 1892, which explains the 188 of the 1899 entries and settles the 118/189/188 drift noted earlier as a scribe's habit with one house. The Kalanj household of Jerko Kalanj and Krnarić Ruže at house 188 in 1899 (this file) therefore shares a house with the Viol household for at least seven years.

rows.name: Marija Kalanj, daughter of Jure Kalanj and Vučetić Manole (house 231, 1891)
rows.relation: daughter of Jure Kalanj and Vučetić Manole, of Brinje house 231 - the household earlier filed as 'Kalauj' - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga rođenih 1888-1900 (DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S), image 157, entry no. 158 - "KALANJ MARISA" (given name read as Marisa, probably a diminutive of Marija), female, born 22 and registered 26 November 1891, of Brinje house 231, daughter of KALANJ JURE and VUČETIĆ MANOLE. Witnesses Čalac(?) Joso i Rumenović Kate, matičar Sertić Šimun. NOT IN THE TREE. THIS ENTRY SETTLES THE KALAUJ QUESTION. It was read in September 2026 as 'Kalauj' and logged as a distinct near-miss family. Re-read at full zoom on 5 October 2026 the surname is KALANJ in every letter - the same word as the unmistakable Kalanj Viol at image 163 - and the parents (Jure, mother Vučetić Manole), the house (231, Niko Kalanj's own house) and the entry's formulae are exactly those of the 1899 birth of Ruže Kalanj (image 450). The 'Kalauj' family does not exist as a separate family: it is the Jure Kalanj x Vučetić Manole household of house 231, with Niko Kalanj (married 1890 to a widow Marija, later entered Vučetić) and a Kalanj Mile x Vučetić Marija at the same house, all inside one Kalanj family.

rows.name: Marko Kalanj, son of Jure Kalanj and Vučetić Ove (1892)
rows.relation: son of Jure Kalanj and Vučetić Ove, of Brinje house 249 - second child of the household earlier filed as 'Kalauj' - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga rođenih 1888-1900 (DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S), image 171, entry no. 42 - "KALANJ MARKO", male, born 14 and registered 15 May 1892, of Brinje house 249, son of KALANJ JURE and VUČETIĆ OVE (Ove/Ave, a short form of Manole as the same woman's name shifts between her children's entries). Witness Trölich Jure i Marija, matičar Sertić Šimun. NOT IN THE TREE. Read in September 2026 as a 'Kalauj' entry and kept out of this file; re-read at full zoom on 5 October 2026 the word is plainly KALANJ, in the same hand as the header of entry 42 itself ('Kalanj Marko'). Second child of the Jure Kalanj x Vučetić household (Marija/Marisa 1891 at house 231, this file; Ruže 1899 at house 231, this file), now at house 249, where Mijo Kalanj (this file) lived. Kalanj men at 249 and 231 are thus one family's two houses.

rows.name: Petar Kalanj, son of Tome Kalanj and Nesić Marija
rows.relation: son of Tome Kalanj and Nesić (read with some doubt) Marija, of Brinje house 188 - a third Kalanj household at that house number - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga rođenih 1888-1900 (DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S), image 155, entry no. 150 - "KALANJ PETAR", male, born 14 and registered 15 November 1891, of Brinje house 188, son of KALANJ TOME and NESIĆ MARIJA. Witnesses Perlić Mijo (the near-miss) i Dražanović Marija, matičar Sertić Šimun. NOT IN THE TREE. A THIRD KALANJ FATHER at house 188 after Viol (Kate 1890, Pave 1892, Marija 1899, this file) and Jerko (Manole 1899, this file): Tome. House 188 is now a Kalanj house with three heads in eight years. Not merged with either. CORRECTION OF 5 OCTOBER 2026 ON THE FULL READABLE-ZOOM RE-READ OF IMAGE 152 (left-hand page, first entry; page 292, entry no. 150): the mother's surname is written MESIĆ, not Nesić. 'Kalanj Petar', male, born 14 and registered 15 November 1891, of Brinje house 188, son of KALANJ TOME and MESIĆ MARIJA; informants 'Perkić Mijo i Dražičević Marica'. The row keeps its name; the mother is Mesić Marija. The Tome Kalanj household at house 188 therefore has a mother Marija (Mesić) in 1891 and, in the first child Mile (October 1888, this file), a mother entered as 'Kalanj Marija': most probably one woman whose maiden name was Mesić and whom the 1888 clerk entered under her husband's surname.

rows.name: Ove Kalanj, daughter of Jure Kalanj and Vučetić Manole (house 231, 1894)
rows.relation: daughter of Jure Kalanj and Vučetić Manole, of Brinje house 231 - the third child of the household earlier filed as 'Kalauj' - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga rođenih 1888-1900 (DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S), image 259, entry no. 76 - "KALANJ OVE", female, born 14 and registered 16 [the first pass wrote February; the entry says August - see the correction at the end of this note] 1894, of Brinje house 231, daughter of KALANJ JURE and VUČETIĆ MANOLE. Witnesses Dražanović Marko i Luce, a later marginal note of 1978. NOT IN THE TREE. Read in September 2026 as a 'Kalauj' entry and kept out of this file; at full zoom on 5 October 2026 the surname is KALANJ and the parents and house are those of Marija/Marisa (1891) and of Ruže (1899), this file. The Jure Kalanj x Vučetić Manole household at house 231 is thus now four children over eight years: Marija/Marisa 1891, Marko 1892 (house 249), Ove 1894 and Ruže 1899. CORRECTED 5 OCTOBER 2026 ON THE READABLE-ZOOM RE-READ (image 259, left-hand page, first entry; page 120): the first pass dated this 14 February 1894. The entry is headed 16 kolovoza and says born 14 kolovoza, that is 14 AUGUST 1894 (registered 16 August), and the child's given name reads ANE rather than Ove (Ove and Ane are variant forms in this hand). Father Kalanj Jure, mother Vučetić Manole, house 231, informants Dražičević Marko i Luce.

rows.name: Mile Kalanj and Marija, witnesses at Lučane (1894)
rows.relation: witnesses to the baptism of Marinović Manda, of Lučane - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga rođenih 1888-1900 (DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S), image 274 (the shown frame is the one after 273; entry 143, Lučane, Marinović Manda, daughter of Marinović Ivan and Šakić(?) Marija; dates read at reduced zoom as born about 2 and registered about 6 December 1894), witness line read "KALANJ MILE i Marija" (the surname read with the usual doubt in this hand, the first pass wrote here that the mother of the child is not Kalanj; THAT WAS WRONG, see the correction at the end of this note). NOT IN THE TREE. A witness pair only. The given names are those of the couple who appear in 1899 as parents of Franc Kalanj at house 231 (Kalanj Mile x Vučetić Marija, this file): if the same pair, they were witnessing at a Lučane baptism five years before their own child's, which is a plausible, unconfirmed link and not a merge. Another sign that the people this register once read as 'Kalauj' are Kalanj kin. CORRECTED 5 OCTOBER 2026 ON THE READABLE-ZOOM RE-READ OF IMAGE 275 (right-hand page, second entry; page 153; the viewer frame is one lower): the child is MARINČIĆ MANOLE (the first pass wrote Marinović Manda), born 2 and registered 6 December 1894, of Lučane, daughter of MARINČIĆ IVAN and, in the mother's column, KALANJ MARIJA, both of Lučane, farmers (the first pass read the mother's surname as Šakić(?) and said it was not Kalanj; at close zoom it is plainly Kalanj). The informants "Kalanj Mile i Marija" therefore stand at the birth of a child whose mother is a Kalanj, which makes them very probably her parents or close kin - a stronger reading than the 'witness pair only' of the first note, but still an inference: the entry does not state the relationship. See the new row for Marija Kalanj, wife of Ivan Marinčić.

rows.name: Manole Kalanj, daughter of Mijo Kalanj and Krnarić Manole (1895)
rows.relation: daughter of Mijo Kalanj and Krnarić Manole, of Brinje house 249 - a child of the February 1892 marriage, missed on the first pass - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga rođenih 1888-1900 (DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S), image 281 (the shown frame follows 280), entry no. 11 - "KALANJ MANOLE", female, born 10 and registered 13 January 1895, of Brinje house 249, daughter of KALANJ MIJO and KRNARIĆ MANOLE. Witnesses Trölich Jure i Marija, matičar Sertić Šimun; a later marginal note of 1949. NOT IN THE TREE. It is the FIRST child on record of the household whose 1899 child Tomo is in this file (Kate Borić, wife of Petar Sertić, Brinje house 128, born 7 August 1899): the same father, mother and house number, four years earlier, which turns that 1899 row from a single sighting into a household. MONTH CORRECTED 5 OCTOBER 2026 ON THE SECOND READABLE-ZOOM READING (image 313, left-hand page, first entry; page 228): the entry is headed 13 listopada and says born 11 listopada, that is OCTOBER 1895, not November. The informants read 'Lasić Stjepan i Borić Jele' (the first letter of Jele's surname is the same looped B as in the mother's own surname).

rows.name: Perković wife of Marko Vuković, mother of Vuković Joso (1895)
rows.relation: mother of Vuković Joso, of Brinje - the Perković bride of the 1893 Vuković marriage, now with a child on record - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga rođenih 1888-1900 (DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S), image 317 (page 236; the viewer shows the frame after 316), entry no. 153 - "VUKOVIĆ JOSO", male, born 9 and registered 10 November 1895, of Brinje (house number read as 103, probably 105 - not clear), son of VUKOVIĆ MARKO and a mother whose surname is written in the hand's 'Perkonić' form (given name read 'Bare' or 'Dare', probably the same name that the marriage entry abbreviates as Đuso), both of Brinje, farmers, Croats. Informants "Kalafatić Mijo i Manda", matičar Sertić Šimun. NOT IN THE TREE. FOUND ON 5 OCTOBER 2026 ON THE RE-READ OF THE 300-318 STRETCH, WHERE THE FIRST PASS HAD FILED THE MOTHER'S SURNAME AS THE 'PERHONIĆ' NEAR-MISS. THAT FILING WAS WRONG HERE. The entry is the child of the marriage already in this file (image 581, Vuković Marko x Perković Đuso, 1893, bride of Brinje house 145, father Perković Jozo): the same father, a mother of the same surname, and the SAME WITNESS, Kalafatić Mijo, who stood at the wedding and is the informant here. And the hand writes its v like an n throughout - the father's own name on the same page is written 'Vukonić' for Vuković - so 'Perkonić' is Perković. The recurring 'Perhonić' of the earlier log is therefore OPEN, not settled: it is at least in part the Perković surname, and every earlier Perhonić sighting has to be re-read before the family page can say how many Perković households Brinje holds.

rows.name: Luce Kalanj, daughter of Jure Kalanj (house 231, 1889)
rows.relation: daughter of Jure Kalanj and Vučetić Manole, of Brinje house 231 - the eldest child of that household found so far, born before the 1891 Marija - not in the tree
rows.date: 28 November 1889 [a second, identical entry is dated 28 December 1889]
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga rođenih 1888-1900 (DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S), image 84 (the viewer shows the frame after 83), entry no. 155, the LAST entry of 1889 - "KALANJ LUCE", female, born 25 and registered 28 December 1889, of Brinje house 231, daughter of KALANJ JURE and VUČETIĆ MANOLE, both of Brinje, farmers, Croats. Informants "Rumenović Tomo i Stoja", matičar Sertić Šimun. NOT IN THE TREE. FOUND ON 5 OCTOBER 2026 ON THE READABLE-ZOOM RE-READ, IN A STRETCH (images 1-299) THE FIRST PASS HAD LOGGED AS READ. A clear Kalanj in a clean hand, missed at spread-fit zoom. It is the same house 231, father Jure and mother Vučetić Manole as the 1891 Marija, the 1892 Marko, the 1894 Ove and the 1899 Ruže Kalanj (this file), so that household now has five children on record across ten years, 1889-1899, and Luce is the oldest. The informant Rumenović Tomo is the same Rimenović Tomo who witnessed the 1890 marriage of Niko Kalanj of house 231 (this file). It is also the name 'Luce Kalanj' that recurs as a witness at house 249 in 1899 (this file), which is a named link, not a proven one: she would have been nine. CORRECTION OF 5 OCTOBER 2026, FOUND ON THE LATER RE-READ OF IMAGE 79: THERE ARE TWO IDENTICAL ENTRIES FOR THIS CHILD. Entry no. 137 (image 79, right-hand page, second entry; page 141) reads 'KALANJ LUCE', female, born 25 and registered 28 NOVEMBER 1889, of Brinje house 231, daughter of Kalanj Jure and Vučetić Manole, informants 'Rumenović Tomo i Stoja'; entry no. 155 (image 84), described above, is the same child with the same parents, house and informants but the month written as DECEMBER (born 25 and registered 28 December). A child cannot be born in both months, so one is a clerical duplication or a wrong month; the entries do not say which, and this row records ONE person with both dates. The row's text above keeps the December entry's citation.

rows.name: Nikola Perković, son of Mile Perković and Marica Perković (Križpolje 22, 1893)
rows.relation: son of Mile Perković and Marica, both of the Perković surname, of Križpolje house 22 - a Perković household in a hamlet of the Brinje parish, not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga rođenih 1888-1900 (DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S), image 233 (the viewer shows the frame after 232), entry no. 138 - the birth of a boy, born 19 and registered 21 October 1893, whose own name and both parents' surnames are written in the hand's 'Perkonić' form: "PERKOVIĆ NIKOLA", son of PERKOVIĆ MILE and PERKOVIĆ MARICA, both of Križpolje house 22, farmers, Croats. Informants "Hranović Niko i Antija", matičar Rubelli Lavoslav (the matičar of 1893; Sertić Šimun signs from 1895). NOT IN THE TREE. FOUND AS A MIS-FILING ON 5 OCTOBER 2026: the first pass logged this entry on 29 September as a possible Perković that 'turned out to be Perhonić, a distinct surname already met twice before'. It was not distinct. The hand writes v like n (the Vuković of the 1893 Vuković-Perković marriage reads 'Vukonić' on the same page as its Perković bride, image 581, and the father at image 317 entry 153 is the same Vuković Marko), so 'Perkonić' is Perković, and this is a Perković household: a father Mile and a mother Marica who both carry the surname, so either two Perković kin who married or a mother recorded under her husband's name - the entry does not say which. It is a different household from Marko, Pere and Miko Perković of Novi Kut and from Jozo Perković of house 145 (this file), and its house number is at Križpolje, not Brinje town. CORRECTED 5 OCTOBER 2026 ON THE READABLE-ZOOM RE-READ: the first pass dated this 21 October 1893. The entry (image 233, right-hand page, second entry; page 69) says born 19 studenoga, that is 19 NOVEMBER 1893, and the neighbouring entries are all late November. The parents are written PERKONIĆ MILE and PERKONIĆ MARICA (v written like n: Perković), both of Križpolje, house 22; informants Krznarić Niko i Matija.

rows.name: Jure Kalanj, son of Jure Kalanj and Vučetić Ane (1896)
rows.relation: son of Jure Kalanj and Vučetić Ane, of Brinje house 249 - a Kalanj child of 1896 with a Vučetić mother, in the stretch the first pass marked as Kalauj near-misses - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga rođenih 1893-1897 (DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S), image 351 (entered as 351 in the viewer, whose own frame label reads one lower), entry no. 111 (the figure is partly cut in the frame) - "KALANJ JURE", male, born 14 and registered 20 September 1896, of Brinje house 249, son of KALANJ JURE and VUČETIĆ ANE (the mother's given name is the one this file also reads as Manole, Ove or Ane in her other children's entries), both of Brinje, farmers, Croats. Informants "Vučetić Joso i Manda", matičar Tausani Josip. NOT IN THE TREE. FOUND ON 5 OCTOBER 2026 ON THE RE-READ OF IMAGES 351-355. A clear Kalanj in a clean hand, and the first of the five-image range the earlier log named for Kalauj sightings that was actually re-read. The couple is the Jure Kalanj and Vučetić woman of the Brinje house-231 household already in this file (Luce 1889, Marija 1891, Marko 1892, Ove 1894, Ruže 1899), a gap between the 1894 and 1899 children: the 1896 entry gives the house as 249 (the number of Mijo Kalanj's household), where the other five children give 231 - either the house number drifted or the family moved, and the entry does not say which, so this is recorded as the same couple on name and mother's surname, not merged as one proven household. The informant Vučetić Joso is the mother's own surname, plausibly her brother or father. CORRECTION OF 5 OCTOBER 2026 (full re-read, image 86): the paragraph above treats this couple as the Jure Kalanj of the house-231 household and explains the house number 249 as drift. That was wrong. Entry no. 9 of January 1890 (image 86, this file: Kalanj Mate) shows a SECOND Jure Kalanj household AT house 249, with a mother written Vičić/Vučetić Ane, informants 'Vučetić Joso i Rumenović Stoja'. The 1896 Jure, born to a mother Ane at house 249, belongs to that house-249 household (with Mate, 1890), not to the house-231 couple whose wife is Vučetić Manole (Luce 1889, Marija 1891, Ove 1894, Ruže 1899). There are two Jure Kalanj men with Vučetić/Vičić wives, one at 231 and one at 249.

rows.name: Kate Borić, daughter of Tome Borić and Jela Borić (house 141, 1896)
rows.relation: daughter of Tome Borić and Jela Borić, of Brinje house 141 - a sixth child of that household, whose own register note gives her married name as Perković - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga rođenih 1893-1897 (DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S), image 354 (entered as 354 in the viewer; page 310 of the register), entry no. 122 (read as 122; the entry below it is plainly 123) - "BORIĆ KATE", female, born 6 and registered 7 October 1896, of Brinje house 141, daughter of BORIĆ TOME and BORIĆ JELA, both of Brinje, farmers, Croats. Informants "Perkić Mijo i Borić Marija", matičar Sertić Šimun. A later marginal note in a different hand reads, at full zoom, "umrla 2/IV 1917 g." (died 2 April 1917) followed by "Perković rođ." (née) - the surname before 'rođ.' is read as Perković with moderate confidence, the 1917 hand being a different one. NOT IN THE TREE. FOUND ON 5 OCTOBER 2026 ON THE RE-READ OF IMAGES 351-355. It is the sixth child on record of the Tome Borić x Jela Borić household of house 141 (Juraj 1888, Petar 1890, Matija 1892, Ove 1894, Luce 1899, this file), between Ove and Luce. Two facts make it matter beyond the count: (1) the 1917 note, if read right, says she married a Perković and died at twenty, a documented Borić-Perković marriage in this parish, which no other row in this file yet holds; (2) the informant is the Perkić Mijo who recurs as a witness at Borić births across the volume (the Stjepan Borić baptism of 1890, the Krnarić and Mesić baptisms of 1899, this file), so that man is now tied to the Borić households as well as to the surname the first pass kept apart from Perković. She is not merged with the Kate Borić who is a wife in the Sertić household of house 128, nor with any other Kate.

rows.name: Marija Kalanj, wife of Ivan Mesić (1896)
rows.relation: mother of Mesić Manole, of Brinje house 176 - a Kalanj woman married into the Mesić surname, not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga rođenih 1893-1897 (DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S), image 355 (entered as 355 in the viewer; page 313), entry no. 128 - "MESIĆ MANOLE", female, born 20 and registered 21 October 1896, of Brinje house 176, daughter of MESIĆ IVAN and KALANJ MARIJA, both of Brinje, farmers, Croats. A third Kalanj woman who married out of the surname (after the Ane Kalanj of Dražičević and the Ane Kalanj of Krmarić, this file). The informant Rumenović Tomo is the same man who stood at the 1889 birth of Luce Kalanj (house 231) and at the 1890 marriage of Niko Kalanj of house 231 (this file), so this Mesić-Kalanj household sits inside the same circle of Kalanj families. Her father is not named by the entry and she is not linked to any Kalanj household here.

rows.name: Luce Perković, wife of Tomo Hofjevac (1898)
rows.relation: mother of Hofjevac Bare, of Brinje house 248 - a second Perković woman married into the Hofjevac family, not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga rođenih (third item on the same film as DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S), image 416 (entered as 416 in the viewer), entry no. 28 - "HOFJEVAC BARE", female, born 30 and registered 31 March 1898, of Brinje house 248 (the first pass logged the house as 249), daughter of HOFJEVAC TOMO and a mother whose surname is written in the hand's 'Perkonić' form, given name LUCE, both of Brinje, farmers, Croats. Informants "Hofjevac Marko i Bare", matičar Sertić Šimun; a later marginal note, not fully legible, refers to a marriage of 1963. NOT IN THE TREE. FOUND AS A MIS-FILING ON 5 OCTOBER 2026: the earlier log recorded this entry as 'Hofjevac Tomo x Perhonić Luce - Perhonić confirmed again as the established near-miss, not Perković'. The hand writes v like n, so the mother's surname is Perković, the same form as the Perković Kate who married Jure Hofjevac at house 148 (image 345, this file). That makes TWO Perković women who married into the Hofjevac family at Brinje - Kate (Jure Hofjevac, house 148, 1896) and Luce (Tomo Hofjevac, house 248, 1898) - the alliance this file's Hofjevac-Borić marriages already hint at. Whether the two women were sisters or the husbands were brothers the entries do not say; no merge is made.

rows.name: Mijo Borić, son of Lojze Borić and Mesić Marica (Kamenica, 1888)

rows.name: Mile Kalanj, son of Tome Kalanj and Marija Kalanj (house 188, 1888)
rows.relation: son of Tome Kalanj and a mother also entered under the Kalanj surname, Marija, of Brinje house 188 - the eldest child on record of the Tome Kalanj household - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga rođenih 1888-1900 (DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S), image 37, entry no. 113 - "KALANJ MILE", male, born 21 and registered 25 October 1888, of Brinje house 188, son of KALANJ TOME and KALANJ MARIJA, both of Brinje, farmers, Croats. Informants "Perkić Mijo i Dražičević Janja", matičar Kanett Rafael. NOT IN THE TREE. FOUND ON 5 OCTOBER 2026 ON THE FULL READABLE-ZOOM RE-READ; the first pass logged this stretch as read and did not record it. The house (188), father (Tome) and mother's given name (Marija) are those of the Tome Kalanj household whose 1891 son Petar is already in this file, where the mother is written Nesić Marija: here the mother's own surname is written Kalanj, which is either a second Marija, a wife entered under her husband's surname, or a misreading of one of the two entries, and the entries do not say which. Recorded as the first child of that household on name, father and house, not merged as a proven household. The name Mile is also that of the Mile Kalanj who is father of Franc Kalanj at house 231 in 1899 (this file), not merged either. SEE THE 1891 ENTRY (Petar Kalanj, image 152): the mother there is MESIĆ Marija, and 'Kalanj Marija' here is probably the same woman entered under her husband's surname.

CONFIRMED 5 OCTOBER 2026: the Ivan Borić household of house 141 with a Borić mother has a second child, Vid (born 12 September 1890, image 106, entry 87), recorded in this file under its earlier misreading as 'Ivo Borić, house 191'.

rows.name: Manole Perković, wife of Niko Jurajić (1889)

rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga rođenih 1888-1900 (DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S), image 52 (right-hand page, first entry; page 87), entry no. 28 - "JURAJIĆ MANOLE", female, born 18 and registered 19 April 1889, of Brinje house 286 (read; possibly 296), daughter of JURAJIĆ NIKO and a mother whose surname is written in the hand's 'Perkonić' form, given name MANOLE, both of Brinje, farmers, Croats. A Niko Jurajić at the same house 286 (Jurajić Manole, April 1889, mother Perković, this file) is probably a brother of Franjo sharing the house.

rows.name: Tome Borić and Jela, informants at Brinje house 128 (1889)

Almost certainly Tome Borić and his wife Jela, of house 141, whose children (Juraj 1888, Petar 1890, Matija 1892, Ove 1894, Kate 1896, Luce 1899) are in this file. It is the earliest sign of the Borić link to the Sertić household at house 128: Petar Sertić's later wife is Kate Borić (1895, 1899), and a Jela Borić stands witness at house 128 in 1895 and 1899 (this file) - so the Borić presence at house 128 begins at least six years before the 1895 birth, with Petar's first wife a Lokmer. The surname reading is clear; that this is the house-141 couple rests on the given names and is not proved.

rows.name: Mate Kalanj, son of Jure Kalanj and Ane Vičić (house 249, 1890)
rows.relation: son of Jure Kalanj and Vičić (or Vučić) Ane, of Brinje house 249 - the first child on record of a Jure Kalanj household at house 249, separate from the Jure Kalanj of house 231 - not in the tree

FOUND ON 5 OCTOBER 2026 ON THE FULL READABLE-ZOOM RE-READ, and it changes how the Kalanj households of house 231 and 249 read. A Kalanj Jure with a Vučetić/Vičić Ane at house 249 in January 1890 cannot be the Jure Kalanj of house 231, whose wife Vučetić Manole bore Luce in November (or December) 1889: two children seven weeks apart cannot share a mother. So there are TWO Jure Kalanj households with Vučetić-family wives: house 231 (wife Manole: Luce 1889, Marija 1891, Ove 1894, Ruže 1899) and house 249 (wife Ane: Mate 1890, and very probably Marko 1892 and the Jure of 1896, this file). The informants Vučetić Joso (this entry) and Vučetić Joso (the 1896 Jure entry) are the same name and suggest the house-249 wife's own family; Rumenović Stoja appears at both houses and is not a Kalanj. Not merged with the house-231 Jure.

rows.name: Ane Kalanj, daughter of Mijo Kalanj and Manole Krnarić (house 249, 1892)
rows.relation: daughter of Mijo Kalanj and Krnarić Manole, of Brinje house 249 - a daughter born ten months AFTER the February 1892 marriage of Mijo Kalanj and Krnarić Manole - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga rođenih 1888-1900 (DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S), image 193 (right-hand page, second entry; page 369), entry no. 131 - "KALANJ ANE", female, born 20 and registered 22 December 1892, of Brinje house 249, daughter of KALANJ MIJO and KRNARIĆ MANOLE, both of Brinje, farmers, Croats. Informants "Krnarić Franjo i Marija", matičar Sertić Šimun. Two later margin notes: a marriage on 4 February 1918 to a man whose surname is not clearly read, and a death on 9 September 1981 at Nova Gradiška (a registry certificate of that year). NOT IN THE TREE. FOUND ON 5 OCTOBER 2026 ON THE FULL READABLE-ZOOM RE-READ, and it raised a contradiction that the marriage entry then resolved: the first pass dated the wedding of Mijo Kalanj and Krnarić Manole 15 [month illegible] 1893, which would have put this December 1892 child before the wedding. RESOLVED 5 OCTOBER 2026: the marriage entry (image 566, page 147) is dated 15 February 1892 - it stands in the 1892 numbering of the marriage book - so Ane was born ten months after her parents married. There was no illegitimacy and no second Krnarić woman; the first pass had misread a digit. The household is Mijo's of house 249 either way: Manole (1895) and Stipe (1899, this file) are her siblings, and the informant Krnarić Franjo is the mother's kin. The margin notes give her a later life (a 1918 marriage and a death in 1981), which most of the Kalanj children in this file lack.
