rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga rođenih 1897-1900 (third item on the same film as DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S), image 487 (left-hand page, first entry; page 164), entry no. 153 - the baptism of "LOHMER PAVE", male, born 24 and registered 31 December (prosinca) 1899, of Brinje house 257, son of LOHMER PAVE and PAVLOVIĆ MARIJA. The informants line reads "Javor Ivan i Kate". A margin note records his marriage on 16 February 1930 and a death notification of 1986 (not fully read). Informants are weak kinship evidence: a Javor Ivan standing with a Kate rather than with Ane fits the unexplained 'Borić Kate' of the 1893 entry of the Ivan Javor household and the Kate of the Ive x Župančić Kate household equally well, and is recorded as a sighting, not as evidence for either. Not merged. FOUND ON 5 OCTOBER 2026 ON THE FULL READABLE-ZOOM RE-READ OF THE THIRD BIRTHS BOOK (images 404-489).

rows.name: Jure Kalanj, bridegroom of 13 August 1888 (house 231)
rows.relation: SON OF VID KALANJ AND JANJA, bachelor aged 27, born at Brinje house 231, who married Vučetić Manole - the marriage behind the Jure Kalanj x Vučetić Manole household of house 231 (Marija 1891, Marko 1892, Ove 1894, Jure 1896, Ruže 1899, this file) - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga vjenčanih 1888-1899 (DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S), image 499 (left-hand page; page 12), entry no. 12 - married at Brinje on 13 (trinaest) kolovoza 1888: bridegroom "KALANJ JURAJ", momak (bachelor), 27 years, born at Brinje house 231, a farmer of Brinje, son of KALANJ VID and JANJA; bride "VUČETIĆ MANOLE", djevojka (maiden), 26 years, born at Brinje house 210, a farmer of Brinje, daughter of VUČETIĆ IVE and JANJA. Witnesses read "Kalanj Juraj" (a namesake of the groom: a kinsman, not the groom) and Rumenović Tomo; the clerk is Kanotti Rafael. NOT IN THE TREE. THIS IS THE DOCUMENT THAT SETTLES THE 'KALAUJ' HOUSEHOLD OF HOUSE 231: the father is Jure/Juraj, the mother Manole Vučetić (written Ove, Ive or Manole in the later baptisms), and his own father is VID Kalanj (the name Viol/Vid recurs among the Kalanj men of Brinje, e.g. Viol Kalanj of house 188 in 1896-99, but no document ties this Vid to him). He is NOT the Niko Kalanj of house 231 whose marriage to a widow Marija (Vučić/Vučetić) is dated 1890 (image 530, this file): that Niko is the son of Juro and Ana. Whether Niko and Jure of house 231 are brothers, or a father's and a son's households sharing a house number, is not established; nothing is merged. FOUND ON 5 OCTOBER 2026 ON THE FULL READABLE-ZOOM RE-READ OF THE MARRIAGE BOOK (images 493-690).

rows.name: Jure Kalanj, bridegroom of 19 November 1888 (house 249)
rows.relation: SON OF A KALANJ FATHER WHOSE GIVEN NAME BEGINS 'LJU-' (unread) AND RUŽE, bachelor aged 25, born at Brinje house 249, who married Vučetić Ove (Ane) of house 210 - the marriage behind the Jure Kalanj x Vučetić Ove household of house 249 (Marko 1892, Jure 1896, this file) - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga vjenčanih 1888-1899 (DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S), image 505 (left-hand page; page 24), entry no. 24 - married at Brinje on 19 (devetnajest) studenoga 1888: bridegroom "KALANJ JURAJ", momak (bachelor), 25 years, born at Brinje house 249, a farmer of Brinje, son of KALANJ [given name read 'Ljubert' or similar, not secure] and RUŽE; bride "VUČETIĆ OVE" (Ane), djevojka (maiden), 17 years, born at Brinje house 210, a farmer of Brinje, daughter of VUČETIĆ JOZO and MARIJA. Witnesses Krnarić Vid and BORIĆ STJEPAN; officiant Šrobi Šimun. NOT IN THE TREE. A SECOND Jure Kalanj marries a Vučetić girl of house 210 in the same autumn (the first on 13 August 1888, groom of house 231, son of Vid, bride Manole, daughter of Ive; this file): the two grooms are different men by father, house and bride, which separates two of the 'three Jure Kalanj households of 1890' (houses 231 and 249) by document; the third (house 188) is still without a marriage. A Borić man, Stjepan, stands witness. FOUND ON 5 OCTOBER 2026 ON THE FULL READABLE-ZOOM RE-READ OF THE MARRIAGE BOOK (images 493-690).

rows.name: Tome Kalanj, bridegroom of 19 November 1888 (house 188)
rows.relation: SON OF IVE KALANJ AND MANOLE, bachelor aged 25, born at Brinje house 188, who married Bublić Kate/Marta of Plašćica 5 - the house 188 is the house of the twin Kalanj boys and of the Jerko and Viol Kalanj households (this file) - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga vjenčanih 1888-1899 (DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S), image 505 (right-hand page; page 25), entry no. 25 - married at Brinje on 19 (devetnajest) studenoga 1888: bridegroom "KALANJ TOME", momak (bachelor), 25 years, born at Brinje house 188, a farmer of Brinje, son of KALANJ IVE and MANOLE; bride "BUBLIĆ MARTA" (read; possibly Kate), djevojka (maiden), 25 years, born at Plašćica 5, a farmer of Plašćica, daughter of BUBLIĆ JURE and LUCE. Witnesses Bublić Vid and Dorčić Ivan; officiant Šrobi Šimun. NOT IN THE TREE. The Kalanj Tome x Mesić Marija household on this file would need a second marriage to be this man's, which no document says: the 1888 bride is a Bublić of Plašćica, the neighbouring hamlet at which Kalanj Niko stands witness to a Bublić birth in 1899 (this file). Not merged with any Kalanj Tome. FOUND ON 5 OCTOBER 2026 ON THE FULL READABLE-ZOOM RE-READ OF THE MARRIAGE BOOK (images 493-690).

rows.name: Ivan Javor, widower bridegroom of 18 November 1888 (house 83)
rows.relation: widower aged 70, born at Brinje house 83, who married the widow Zoričić Matija (Katija) of Brinje house 92 - an OLD Javor Ivan of house 83, not the Javor Ivan x Borić Ane of the births - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga vjenčanih 1888-1899 (DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S), image 504 (left-hand page; page 22), entry no. 22 - married at Brinje on 18 (osamnajest) studenoga 1888: bridegroom "JAVOR IVAN", udovac (widower), 70 years, born at Brinje house 83, a farmer of Brinje; bride "ZORIČIĆ MATIJA" (the given name is read Matija or Katija), udovica (widow), aged about 52-57 (the figure is not secure), born at Brinje house 92, a farmer of Brinje. The parents' lines are left blank. Witness Sertić Ivan; officiant Šrobi Šimun. NOT IN THE TREE. A MAN BORN ABOUT 1818 at house 83 and widowed by 1888 cannot be the father of the five children of Javor Ivan x Borić Ane (Ruže 1891, Ivan 1893, Marica 1895, Luce-Mila 1896, Ane 1898, this file) unless the bride's age and the entry are both misread: the most economical reading is TWO Javor Ivans at house 83, an old widower who in 1888 married a Zoričić widow and a younger Ivan (his son?) whose wife is Borić Ane. CONFIRMED THE SAME DAY: the marriage of 15 September 1890 (image 534, Javor Ivan x Borić Ove, this file) names the younger Javor Ivan of house 83 as the son of Javor Ivan and Marija and has Javor Ivan as a witness: the two are father and son. The father's first wife (Marija?) predates 1888; his second wife is the Zoričić widow of this entry. Not merged with the Javor Ive/Ivica x Župančić Kate household. FOUND ON 5 OCTOBER 2026 ON THE FULL READABLE-ZOOM RE-READ OF THE MARRIAGE BOOK (images 493-690).

rows.name: Manole Javor, bride of 26 September 1888 (house 82)
rows.relation: DAUGHTER OF MARKO JAVOR AND ANA, maiden aged 25, born at Brinje house 82, who married Jelačić Stjepan of Brinje house 104 - a Javor household of house 82 - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga vjenčanih 1888-1899 (DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S), image 501 (left-hand page; page 16), entry no. 16 - married at Brinje on 26 (dvadesetšest) rujna 1888: bridegroom "JELAČIĆ STJEPAN", momak (bachelor), 27 years, born at Brinje house 104, son of Jelačić Ivan and Ruža; bride "JAVOR MANOLE", djevojka (maiden), 25 years, born at Brinje house 82, a farmer of Brinje, daughter of JAVOR MARKO and ANA. Witnesses Kunčić(?) Jozo and Jakšević(?) Franjo; officiant Kanotti Rafael. NOT IN THE TREE. Javor Marko and Ana of house 82 are the parents of a woman born about 1863; the Javor Ive x Župančić Kate household of houses 82/83 (1895-1899, this file) may be their grandson's, but nothing says so. Not merged. FOUND ON 5 OCTOBER 2026 ON THE FULL READABLE-ZOOM RE-READ OF THE MARRIAGE BOOK (images 493-690).

rows.name: Manole Borić, bride of 26 November 1888 (Kamenica)
rows.relation: DAUGHTER OF JOSIP BORIĆ AND ANA, maiden aged 20, born at Kamenica, who married Petrinić Ivan of Brinje house 56 - the Manole Borić wife of Ive Petrinić at house 56 (Jure, September 1898, this file) is very probably this woman - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga vjenčanih 1888-1899 (DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S), image 507 (left-hand page; page 28), entry no. 28 - married at Brinje on 26 (dvadesetšest) studenoga 1888: bridegroom "PETRINIĆ IVAN", momak (bachelor), 30 years, born at Brinje house 56, a farmer of Brinje, son of PETRINIĆ JURE and MARIJA; bride "BORIĆ MANOLE", djevojka (maiden), 20 years, born at Kamenica (the house number reads 20 or 23), a farmer of Kamenica, daughter of BORIĆ JOSIP (read; Josip/Jozo) and ANE. Witnesses Lohmer Jure and Marko; officiant Šrobi Šimun. NOT IN THE TREE. The groom's house 56 and his given name Ive/Ivan are those of the Petrinić household in the 1898 birth of Petrinić Jure to Ive Petrinić and Borić Manole of house 56 (this file); a Petrinić Jure who is also the groom's father's name would be a child named for his grandfather. This is the likeliest identification, not a proof. FOUND ON 5 OCTOBER 2026 ON THE FULL READABLE-ZOOM RE-READ OF THE MARRIAGE BOOK (images 493-690).

rows.name: Grgo Borić, bridegroom of 21 January 1889 (house 126)
rows.relation: SON OF VID (VIOL) BORIĆ AND MARIJA, bachelor aged 24, born at Brinje house 126, who married Milaković Marija of Brinje house 74 - the Grgo Borić x Milaković Marija household of house 126 (Stjepan 1893, Ana 1894, Manole 1899, this file) - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga vjenčanih 1888-1899 (DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S), image 510 (left-hand page; page 34), entry no. 3 of 1889 - married at Brinje on 21 (dvadesetjedan) siječnja 1889: bridegroom "BORIĆ GRGO", momak (bachelor), 24 years, born at Brinje house 126, a farmer of Brinje, son of BORIĆ VIOL (Vid) and MARIJA; bride "MILAKOVIĆ MARIJA", djevojka (maiden), 19 years, born at Brinje house 74, a farmer of Brinje, daughter of MILAKOVIĆ IVAN and MANOLE. Witnesses Milaković Grgo and Dražanović Marko; officiant Šrobi Šimun. NOT IN THE TREE. THE DOCUMENT BEHIND THE STEADIEST GRGO BORIĆ HOUSEHOLD OF THE BIRTHS: groom's father is Vid/Viol Borić of house 126, the bride is the Milaković Marija whose three children (1893, 1894, 1899) are registered at house 126 with exactly these parents' names. The Ivan/Ive Borić of house 126 (father of Juko and the widow Luce Borić, this file) is not named here and is not merged with Vid. FOUND ON 5 OCTOBER 2026 ON THE FULL READABLE-ZOOM RE-READ OF THE MARRIAGE BOOK (images 493-690).

rows.name: Vid Javor, bridegroom of 11 February 1889 (house 70)
rows.relation: SON OF MIJO JAVOR AND MARIJA, bachelor aged 27, born at Brinje house 70, who married Karakaš Ruže of Brinje house 217 - the Javor Viol x Karakaš Ruža household of house 70 (Manole, August 1899, this file) - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga vjenčanih 1888-1899 (DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S), image 512 (left-hand page; page 38), entry no. 7 of 1889 - married at Brinje on 11 (jedanaest) veljače 1889: bridegroom "JAVOR VID", momak (bachelor), 27 years, born at Brinje house 70, a farmer of Brinje, son of JAVOR MIJO and MARIJA; bride "KARAKAŠ RUŽE", djevojka (maiden), 23 years, born at Brinje house 217, a farmer of Brinje, daughter of KARAKAŠ MIJO and ANE. Witnesses Milaković Vid and Karakaš Vid; officiant Šrobi Šimun. NOT IN THE TREE. This gives the Javor household of house 70 its father: Vid (Viol), son of Mijo and Marija Javor, and a Karakaš wife - a THIRD Javor household at house 70 beside Javor Pave x Perković Kate and Javor Jozo x Perkić Luce (this file). Whether Pave, Jozo and Vid are brothers, sons of Mijo, is not established; the house number makes it likely and nothing is merged. FOUND ON 5 OCTOBER 2026 ON THE FULL READABLE-ZOOM RE-READ OF THE MARRIAGE BOOK (images 493-690).

rows.name: Niko Perković, witness at the marriage of Mesić Stjepan (1889)
rows.relation: WITNESS (written Perkonić, v as n) to the marriage of Mesić Stjepan of Brinje house 122 and Krnarić Marija of house 24 - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga vjenčanih 1888-1899 (DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S), image 523 (right-hand page; page 61), entry no. 30 - married at Brinje on 25 (dvadesetpet) studenoga 1889: bridegroom "MESIĆ STJEPAN", momak (bachelor), 28 years, born at Brinje house 122, son of Mesić Niko and Marta; bride "KRNARIĆ MARIJA", djevojka (maiden), 21 years, born at Brinje house 24, daughter of Krnarić Jure and Kate. Witnesses "Perkonić Niko" and "Mesić Niko"; officiant Šrobi Šimun. NOT IN THE TREE. A Perković man, Niko, stands as first witness: the hand writes v like n (Perkonić = Perković, proven at image 126 of the births book), and the word is the long one, not the short Perkić. He is not tied to any Perković household in this file; nothing shows that the Mesić groom is the Stipo/Stjepan Mesić of Kamenica whose wife is Borić Matija (this file), whose house is not 122. FOUND ON 5 OCTOBER 2026 ON THE FULL READABLE-ZOOM RE-READ OF THE MARRIAGE BOOK (images 493-690).

rows.name: Marija Javor, bride of 9 February 1890 (house 90)
rows.relation: DAUGHTER OF STJEPAN JAVOR AND MARIJA, maiden aged 22, born at Brinje house 90, who married Krnarić Franjo of house 208 - a Javor household of house 90 - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga vjenčanih 1888-1899 (DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S), image 527 (right-hand page; page 71), entry no. 9 of 1890 - married at Brinje on 9 (devet) veljače 1890: bridegroom "KRNARIĆ FRANJO", momak (bachelor), 31 years, born at Brinje house 208, son of Krnarić Josip and Marija; bride "JAVOR MARIJA", djevojka (maiden), 22 years, born at Brinje house 90 (read), a farmer of Brinje, daughter of JAVOR STJEPAN and MARIJA. Witnesses read Šabić Dragutin and Župan Mile; officiant Šrobi Šimun. NOT IN THE TREE. A FIFTH Javor family of Brinje after Marko and Ana of house 82 (Manole, 1888), Ivan of house 83, Mijo and Marija of house 70 (Vid, 1889) and Mile of house 92 (births, this file): the Javor surname is spread over houses 70, 82, 83, 90 and 92, and no document yet joins any two of them. A Javor Ivan also stands as second witness at the marriage of Rumenović Marko and Majtanić Ruža on 10 February 1890 (image 528, page 73). FOUND ON 5 OCTOBER 2026 ON THE FULL READABLE-ZOOM RE-READ OF THE MARRIAGE BOOK (images 493-690).

rows.name: Ove Borić, bride of 15 September 1890 (Kamenica 24)
rows.relation: DAUGHTER OF NIKO BORIĆ AND RUŽE (Rase, read), maiden aged 20, born at Kamenica house 24, who married Javor Ivan of Brinje house 83, son of Javor Ivan and Marija - the Javor Ivan x Borić Ove/Ane household (Ruže 1891, Ivan 1893, Marica 1895, Luce-Mila 1896, Ane 1898, this file) - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga vjenčanih 1888-1899 (DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S), image 534 (right-hand page; page 83), entry no. 21 - married at Brinje on 15 (petnajest) rujna 1890: bridegroom "JAVOR IVAN", momak (bachelor), 26 years, born at Brinje house 83, a farmer of Brinje, SON OF JAVOR IVAN AND MARIJA; bride "BORIĆ OVE" (read; Ove, the given name of the 1891 birth entry), djevojka (maiden), 20 years, born at Kamenica house 24, a farmer of Kamenica, daughter of BORIĆ NIKO and RUŽE. Witnesses "Javor Ivan" (the groom's father) and Bosnić Anton; officiant Šrobi Šimun. NOT IN THE TREE. THIS DOCUMENT SETTLES THE JAVOR IVAN QUESTION OF HOUSE 83: the old widower Javor Ivan, born about 1818 at house 83 (marriage of 18 November 1888 to the widow Zoričić Matija, this file), is the FATHER; the younger Javor Ivan, born about 1864 at the same house, is his son and the husband of Borić Ove, whose children are registered 1891-1898. Two men, father and son, both Javor Ivan, at house 83; the 'Ane Borić' of the births is this Borić Ove (Ane/Ove: one woman, the given name read both ways), and the bride's father Borić Niko of Kamenica 24 is the Niko Borić household of that house. The Javor Ive/Ivica x Župančić Kate household (houses 82-83, 1895-99) is still a separate man. FOUND ON 5 OCTOBER 2026 ON THE FULL READABLE-ZOOM RE-READ OF THE MARRIAGE BOOK (images 493-690).

rows.name: Marija Borić, widow Bišanić, bride of 23 November 1890
rows.relation: DAUGHTER OF JURE BORIĆ AND MARIJA, widow aged 33, born at Brinje house 191, entered under her married name Bišanić, who married the widower Bišanić Ferok (Jerok) of house 206 - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga vjenčanih 1888-1899 (DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S), image 536 (left-hand page; page 86), entry no. 24 - married at Brinje on 23 (dvadesettri) studenoga 1890: bridegroom "BIŠANIĆ FEROK" (Jerok), udovac (widower), 45 years, born at Brinje house 206, son of Bišanić Marko and Matija; bride "BIŠANIĆ MARIJA", udovica (widow), 33 years, born at Brinje house 191, daughter of BORIĆ JURE and MARIJA - her father's surname is Borić, so she is a Borić by birth and a Bišanić by her first marriage. Witnesses Krnarić Frano and Bišanić Vid; officiant Šrobi Šimun. NOT IN THE TREE. A Borić daughter of Jure Borić and Marija: house 191 was once read for a Borić birth of September 1890 (later corrected to house 141, this file), so this entry is the only document that places a Borić family at house 191. Not merged with any Marija Borić. FOUND ON 5 OCTOBER 2026 ON THE FULL READABLE-ZOOM RE-READ OF THE MARRIAGE BOOK (images 493-690).

rows.name: Manole Perković, bride of 19 January 1891 (house 115)
rows.relation: DAUGHTER OF JOZO PERKOVIĆ AND MARIJA, maiden aged 23, born at Brinje house 115 (read), who married Kalafatić Mijo of Brinje house 81 - her surname is written PERHONIĆ here (h and k, v as n: Perhonić = Perković) - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga vjenčanih 1888-1899 (DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S), image 543 (left-hand page; page 100), entry no. 3 of 1891 - married at Brinje on 19 (devetnajst) siječnja 1891: bridegroom "KALAFATIĆ MIJO", neoženjen (bachelor), 26 years, born at Brinje house 81, son of Kalafatić Petar and Manole; bride "PERHONIĆ MANOLE", neudata (unmarried), 23 years, born at Brinje house 115, a farmer of Brinje, daughter of PERHONIĆ JOZO and MARIJA. Witnesses Lohmer Tomo and Župančić Ivan; officiant Šrobi Šimun. NOT IN THE TREE. THE FIRST PERKOVIĆ BRIDE OF THE FULL RE-READ, and the spelling that the first pass kept apart: the surname is written with h (Perhonić) in the marriage clerk's hand, with the n-for-v letterform (compare the Perkonić of the births, image 126), so Perhonić = Perković. A Perković family of Brinje house 115, the father Jozo and mother Marija; the Perković Jozo x Marija household is not otherwise on record, and nothing joins it to the Perković households of Novi Kut and house 145 (this file). FOUND ON 5 OCTOBER 2026 ON THE FULL READABLE-ZOOM RE-READ OF THE MARRIAGE BOOK (images 493-690).

rows.name: Marko Perlić (Perkić?), widower bridegroom of 3 August 1891 (house 101)
rows.relation: WIDOWER aged 58, a čizmar (shoemaker), born at Brinje house 101, who married the widow Sertić Kate of Kamenica 13 - the surname is written PERLIĆ (the middle letter reads l, possibly k) - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga vjenčanih 1888-1899 (DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S), image 548 (left-hand page; page 110), entry no. 13 of 1891 - married at Brinje on 3 (tri) kolovoza 1891: bridegroom "PERLIĆ MARKO" (read), udovac (widower), 58 years, born at Brinje house 101, a čizmar (shoemaker) of Brinje; bride "SERTIĆ KATE", udovica (widow), 58 (or 38) years, born at Kamenica house 13, a farmer of Kamenica. The parents' lines are blank. Witnesses Javor Stjepan and Rumenović Tome; officiant Šrobi Šimun. NOT IN THE TREE. The word is Perlić, not Perkić: the same family of house 101 is written PERLIĆ again at close zoom in the marriage of Perlić Mijo (28 February 1892, image 567, page 149), a bachelor of 32 born at house 101, son of PERLIĆ TOMO and ANE, who married Vičić Kata of house 117 - so Perlić Marko the shoemaker (b. about 1833) and Perlić Mijo (b. about 1860) are two Perlić men of one house, probably uncle or father and son. Perlić is a name on its own, distinct from the standing informant Perkić Mijo and from Perković; nothing is merged. FOUND ON 5 OCTOBER 2026 ON THE FULL READABLE-ZOOM RE-READ OF THE MARRIAGE BOOK (images 493-690).

rows.name: Luce Borić, bride of 22 November 1891 (Kamenica 5)
rows.relation: DAUGHTER OF MARKO BORIĆ AND MANOLE, maiden aged 25, born at Kamenica house 5, who married the widower Bišanić Marko of Brinje house 178-179 - the Marko Bišanić x Luce Borić household of the births (Niko 1892, Franjo 1894, this file) - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga vjenčanih 1888-1899 (DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S), image 553 (left-hand page; page 120), entry no. 23 of 1891 - married at Brinje on 22 (dvadesetdva) studenoga 1891: bridegroom "BIŠANIĆ MARKO", udovac (widower), 39 years, born at Brinje house 178 (the house number reads 178 or 179), son of Bišanić Mijo and Manole; bride "BORIĆ LUCE", neudata (unmarried), 25 years, born at Kamenica house 5, a farmer of Kamenica, daughter of BORIĆ MARKO and MANOLE. Witnesses Bosnić Ferok and Pavlić(?) Marko; officiant Šrobi Šimun. NOT IN THE TREE. THIS IS THE MARRIAGE BEHIND THE LUCE BORIĆ WHO IS THE MOTHER OF BIŠANIĆ (BIĆANIĆ) NIKO (27 November 1892, house 179) AND FRANJO (11 August 1894, house 174) IN THIS FILE: the same groom surname, the same given name Marko, the right year (a first child within the year); her father is BORIĆ MARKO of Kamenica, a Borić man this file otherwise meets only as the name 'Borić Marko' standing witness (Lučane, 1893) and as the father of 'Borić Marko' the child of Luce Borić of Kamenica (1891). Whether the unmarried mother Luce Borić of Kamenica who bore a Marko in October 1891 (this file) is the same woman, a month before this marriage, is not established but is plain on the dates. Nothing is merged. FOUND ON 5 OCTOBER 2026 ON THE FULL READABLE-ZOOM RE-READ OF THE MARRIAGE BOOK (images 493-690).

rows.name: Marija Kalanj, bride of 24 January 1892 (house 231)
rows.relation: DAUGHTER OF JOSO KALANJ AND RUŽE, maiden aged 21, born at Brinje house 231, who married Marinčić Ivan of Lučane house 24 - the Marija Kalanj wife of Ivan Marinčić at Lučane (Manole 1894, Marija 1896, this file) - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga vjenčanih 1888-1899 (DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S), image 562 (right-hand page; page 141), entry no. 12 of 1892 - married at Brinje on 24 (dvadesetčetri) siječnja 1892: bridegroom "MARINČIĆ IVAN", momak (bachelor), 30 years, born at Lučane house 24, son of Marinčić Jure and Marija; bride "KALANJ MARIJA", djevojka (maiden), 21 years, born at Brinje house 231, a farmer of Brinje, daughter of KALANJ JOSO and RUŽE. Witnesses Žutac(?) Joso and Javor Ivan; officiant Šrobi Šimun. NOT IN THE TREE. THIS IS THE MARRIAGE BEHIND THE KALANJ WOMAN OF LUČANE whom the first pass of the births read as a Šakić: Marija Kalanj of house 231, daughter of a Kalanj Joso and Ruže. A THIRD Kalanj man at house 231 (beside Jure, son of Vid, and Niko, son of Juro and Ana, this file): Joso Kalanj and his wife Ruže, whose daughter is born about 1871. Whether Joso is a brother of Niko (son of Juro) is not established. Javor Ivan, a Javor man of Brinje, stands as second witness. FOUND ON 5 OCTOBER 2026 ON THE FULL READABLE-ZOOM RE-READ OF THE MARRIAGE BOOK (images 493-690).

rows.name: Marija Javor, bride of 23 October 1892 (house 118)
rows.relation: DAUGHTER OF VID JAVOR AND MARIJA, maiden aged 22, born at Brinje house 118, who married the widower Atalić(?) Jure of Križpolje - another Javor household, of house 118 - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga vjenčanih 1888-1899 (DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S), image 572 (left-hand page; page 158), entry no. 29 of 1892 - married at Brinje on 23 (dvadesettri) listopada 1892: bridegroom "ATALIĆ JURE" (read), udovac (widower), born at Otočac 1, an opančar (maker of opanci, leather shoes) living at Križpolje, son of Atalić Jakov and Marija; bride "JAVOR MARIJA", djevojka (maiden), 22 years, born at Brinje house 118, a farmer of Brinje, daughter of JAVOR VID (Viol) and MARIJA. Witnesses Jurčić Jakov and Jelačić Tome; officiant Šrobi Šimun. NOT IN THE TREE. The Javor families of the births and marriages now stand at houses 70 (Mijo and Marija, and their son Vid x Karakaš Ruže), 82, 83, 90 (Stjepan and Marija), 92 and 118 (Vid and Marija): a Vid (Viol) Javor appears at house 70 as the son of Mijo (1889) and at house 118 as the father of Marija (1892), and the two are not shown to be one man. Nothing is merged. FOUND ON 5 OCTOBER 2026 ON THE FULL READABLE-ZOOM RE-READ OF THE MARRIAGE BOOK (images 493-690).

rows.name: Niko Perković, witness at the marriage of Koričić Joso (1892)
rows.relation: WITNESS (written Perhonić, v as n) to the marriage of Koričić Joso of Brinje house 282 and Dražanović Marija of house 173 - a second Perković Niko witness - not in the tree
rows.citation: FamilySearch, Croatia Church Books 1516-1994, Brinje Matična knjiga vjenčanih 1888-1899 (DGS 005498262, waypoint 9R26-82S), image 568 (right-hand page; page 151), entry no. 22 of 1892 - married at Brinje on 5 (pet) svibnja 1892: bridegroom "KORIČIĆ JOSO", momak (bachelor), 19 years, born at Brinje house 282, son of Koričić Tome and Marija; bride "DRAŽANOVIĆ MARIJA", djevojka (maiden), 19 years, born at Brinje house 173, daughter of Dražanović Stjepan and Kate. Witnesses read "Javor Ive" and "Perhonić Niko"; officiant Šrobi Šimun. NOT IN THE TREE. Perhonić = Perković by the same reading as the bride of 19 January 1891 (this file): a Perković man named Niko, adult enough to witness a marriage, in 1892 as in the marriage of Mesić Stjepan (November 1889, this file). Whether the two Perković Niko witnesses are one man is not established. A Javor Ive stands as first witness. FOUND ON 5 OCTOBER 2026 ON THE FULL READABLE-ZOOM RE-READ OF THE MARRIAGE BOOK (images 493-690).
